original_sentence: The efforts of Tu and her team finally paid off.
readingExamples: The efforts of Tu and her team finally paid off.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. (of an effort, plan or risk) to be successful and bring good results after a period of hard work
(2) phr. v. to pay back money that you owe in full
(3) phr. v. to pay someone what they are owed and dismiss them from a job
(4) phr. v. to pay someone money to prevent them from doing or saying something (informal)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 付钱打发（某人）以使其保持沉默；收买
uncommonMeanings.example: The witness had been quietly paid off, and now, staring at the empty courtroom seat, the young lawyer understood why the truth had slipped through his fingers. （读后续写·悬疑正义）

posExamples.sentence: After years of failed trials and sleepless nights, Tu's persistence finally paid off — the moment the data proved positive, tears of relief streamed silently down her weary face. （读后续写·科研突破）
I am delighted to report that our month-long recycling campaign has truly paid off, with over two tonnes of waste sorted and reused. （应用文·活动汇报）
Hard work does not always pay off immediately, yet history repeatedly shows that those who persevere in silence are the ones who eventually reap the richest rewards. （议论文·坚持的价值）
It took him a decade of frugal living, but at last he paid off every penny of his family's debt and stood, for the first time, truly free. （读后续写·励志人生）

wordForms.other: 不规则变化 pay - paid - paid；名词化 payoff（the payoff of years of effort 多年努力的回报）；同族 pay 短语群见高级表达卡

idioms.translation: （努力/冒险）取得成功、有回报；还清（欠款）；付钱打发（使沉默）
idioms.example: Years of quiet effort finally paid off, and at last she could pay off every debt she owed. （一句同现“奏效”与“还清”两义）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（物作主语）（努力/计划/冒险）成功，奏效，达到目的，有了回报
collocations.example: All her effort paid off in the end, and she finally passed the exam. 她的所有努力最终有了收获——她终于通过了考试。（课件·物作主语）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（人作主语）付清（还清）债务
collocations.example: I'll pay off all my debts first. 首先我要还清欠款。（课件·人作主语·还清债务）

collocations.translation: 【课件】付清某人工资并解雇某人
collocations.example: Two hundred workers have been paid off. 两百名工人拿到工资被解雇了。（课件·pay sb off）
I will pay for the book whatever the price. （课件·完成句子原句·pay for）

collocations.translation: 【课件】偿还某人；报答（也可作报复）
collocations.example: How can I pay you back for all your kindness? （课件·完成句子原句·pay back）
I paid a visit to Mr. and Mrs. Smith yesterday afternoon. （课件·完成句子原句·pay a visit to）

collocations.translation: 某人的努力终于有了回报（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The efforts of Tu and her team finally paid off. （课文原句词块·努力终得回报）
When she saw her students' names on the honour roll, she knew all her efforts had finally paid off. （读后续写·师生情）

collocations.phrase: pay off a debt / loan / mortgage
collocations.translation: 还清债务 / 贷款 / 房贷
collocations.example: By working two jobs, the couple managed to pay off their loan three years ahead of schedule. （应用文·个人经历）
The champion's tearful speech reminded every young athlete that hard work always pays off in the end. （议论文·励志主题）
Investing everything in the startup was a huge risk, but it paid off spectacularly within a year. （议论文·风险与回报）
Patience finally paid off: after months of careful observation, the young birdwatcher captured the rare crane on film. （读后续写·自然探索）
Her decision to learn coding at night school paid off handsomely when she landed her dream job. （应用文·经验分享）

collocations.phrase: in the long run it pays off
collocations.example: Reading widely may seem time-consuming, but in the long run it pays off in ways no shortcut ever could. （议论文·阅读价值）

synonyms.example: Against all odds, the daring rescue plan succeeded. （读后续写·危机化解）
synonyms.usage: 最通用的“成功”，主语可以是人或计划，可及物可不及物；pay off 特指付出努力/冒险后有了回报，隐含“值得、有回报”之意，主语多为 effort/risk/hard work 等。

synonyms.example: Years of patient teaching finally bore fruit when the shy boy stood up and delivered a flawless speech. （读后续写·成长蜕变）
synonyms.usage: 比喻性表达，强调长期付出结出果实，续写和议论文中显文采；与 pay off 语义相近但更书面，主语常为长期的努力/耕耘。

synonyms.example: The extra hours of practice proved worthwhile the day she won the national contest. （应用文·感悟）
synonyms.usage: 强调“事后证明值得”，突出价值判断，后常接 to do；pay off 更强调“产生了实际回报、见到成效”。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·not until 强调句（It was not until...that...）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】It is / was + not until + 时间/条件 + that + 主句其余部分（与 not... until... 结合）；强调“直到……才……”。强调结构去掉 It was ... that 后主句仍成立
advancedExpressions.example: 然而，直到20世纪70年代，屠呦呦经过多次失败的实验才成功发现青蒿素。It was not until the 1970s that Tu succeeded in discovering qinghaosu, after many failed experiments. （课件·Reading原句）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·not until 强调句·仿写（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件·仿写】原句 → It was not until ... that ... 改写
advancedExpressions.example: He didn't realize his mistake until his partner pointed it out. → It was not until his partner pointed it out that he realized his mistake. （课件·仿写1）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·not until 强调句·仿写（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件·仿写】原句 → It was not until ... that ... 改写
advancedExpressions.example: We didn't come back home until we got the result. → It was not until we got the result that we came back home. （课件·仿写2）

advancedExpressions.expression: pay off（奏效/还清）；pay back（偿还；报复）；pay for（为……付款/付出代价）；pay up（（不情愿地）付清）；pay in（存入）
advancedExpressions.example: He paid off his loan, paid back a friend's kindness, and never once made others pay for his own mistakes. （一句串起 pay off / pay back / pay for）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“奏效/有回报”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: pay off ≈ succeed ≈ bear fruit ≈ prove worthwhile ≈ work out（“努力见到成效”功能上可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: All the effort finally paid off / bore fruit / proved worthwhile. （三种说法在此句功能可替换，语体递升）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·动词短语名词化
advancedExpressions.expression: pay off(动词短语) → payoff / pay-off(名词，回报、收益、结局)
advancedExpressions.example: The payoff of those sleepless nights was a discovery that saved millions of lives. （用名词 payoff 承接前文努力）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·及物/不及物 + 代词位置
advancedExpressions.expression: 不及物：efforts pay off（努力奏效）；及物：pay off a debt / pay a debt off（代词须置中：pay it off, 不可 pay off it）
advancedExpressions.example: She finally paid the mortgage off — better still, she paid it off early. （示范代词 it 须插在中间）

advancedExpressions.expression: all the ... had not been in vain — it had finally paid off
advancedExpressions.example: In that shining moment, she realized all the sacrifice had not been in vain — every sleepless night had finally paid off. （否定转折+升华，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am pleased to report that ... has paid off, as evidenced by ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am pleased to report that our joint effort has paid off, as evidenced by the record turnout at Saturday's charity fair. （汇报套路+数据支撑，客观有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: perseverance seldom fails to pay off, provided that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Perseverance seldom fails to pay off, provided that it is guided by a clear goal rather than blind stubbornness. （辩证条件句，避免绝对化）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Their hard work was successful at last.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: At long last, the countless hours of toil and the quiet tears no one had seen paid off, blossoming into a triumph sweeter than any of them had dared to imagine. （读后续写·情感高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: At long last 时间状语强调 + pay off 替换 successful + blossoming into 分词表结果 + 比喻(sweeter than...)

sentenceUpgrade.original: If we keep trying, we will succeed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: History has shown, time and again, that sustained effort rarely fails to pay off — those who refuse to give up are precisely the ones destiny tends to reward. （议论文·论证升级）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: History has shown 引论证 + time and again 强调 + rarely fails to 双重否定显严谨 + those who... 定语从句突出主题

classPractice.question: After years of trial and error, the efforts of Tu and her team finally paid ____.

original_sentence: In November 1972, through trial and error, they successfully discovered qinghaosu—the most effective part of the qinghao extract.
readingExamples: In November 1972, through trial and error, they successfully discovered qinghaosu—the most effective part of the qinghao extract.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a mistake, especially one that causes problems or affects the result of something
(2) n. the state of being wrong in behaviour, belief or judgement
(3) n. (technical) the difference between a computed or measured value and the true or correct value
(4) n. (computing) a fault in a program or device that prevents it from working properly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）错误的行为 / 道德上的过失；罪过
uncommonMeanings.example: Standing alone in the dim chapel, the old man finally begged forgiveness for the errors of his youth, errors that had haunted him for half a century. （读后续写·忏悔救赎）

posExamples.sentence: A single error in the final calculation sent the whole team back to square one, yet no one complained — through trial and error, they had learned that failure was simply the price of discovery. （读后续写·科研坚持）
I am writing to point out a small error in the schedule you published yesterday: the lecture is on Friday, not Thursday. （应用文·纠错信）
To err is human; what truly matters is not whether we make errors, but whether we possess the courage to admit them and the wisdom to learn from them. （议论文·对待错误）
The young pilot's face turned pale as the screen flashed a fatal error, his trembling hands frozen above the controls. （读后续写·紧张危机）

wordForms.noun: error（错误）/ erratum（勘误，复数 errata）
wordForms.adjective: erroneous（错误的，不正确的）/ errant（出格的，犯错的）
wordForms.other: 拉丁词根 err-(漫游、走岔) → error（走岔了的结果=错误）、err（动词）、erroneous（形容词）；固定短语 trial and error（反复试验）、in error（错误地）、the error of one's ways（错误行径）；谚语 To err is human（人非圣贤，孰能无过）

idioms.example: There was no manual to follow; the young inventor built his machine purely through trial and error, learning as much from each failure as from each small success. （读后续写·发明创造）

idioms.translation: 自己的错误行为（并悔改）
idioms.example: It took a stranger's kindness to make him see the error of his ways and turn his life around. （读后续写·人物转变）

idioms.translation: 一连串滑稽的差错（源自莎士比亚）
idioms.example: The school picnic turned into a comedy of errors — the wrong bus, the forgotten food, and the sudden rain — yet somehow it became the day everyone remembered most fondly. （读后续写·趣味回忆）

collocations.translation: 通过反复试验（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In November 1972, through trial and error, they successfully discovered qinghaosu. （课文原句词块·反复试验）

collocations.translation: 犯错误（error 为可数名词，需加冠词）
collocations.example: Even the most careful surgeon may make an error, which is precisely why hospitals build in layers of safety checks. （议论文·制度保障）

collocations.translation: 错误地；由于失误（副词性固定搭配，无冠词）
collocations.example: The parcel was delivered to the wrong house in error and had to be traced for days. （14词·投递失误）
In November 1972, through trial and error, they at last isolated the active compound. （议论文·科研方法）

collocations.translation: 致命的 / 严重的错误
collocations.example: One serious error in judgement cost the expedition its only chance of reaching the summit. （读后续写·探险挫折）
The essay was brilliant in argument but marred by several careless spelling errors. （应用文·作文点评）
She read the report twice before submitting it, hoping to spot any error that might embarrass the team. （应用文·工作态度）
Investigators concluded that the accident was caused not by faulty equipment but by simple human error. （议论文·责任分析）
In such a delicate operation, the margin of error was almost zero. （读后续写·紧张情节）
Great scientists are not those who never err, but those who learn from their errors most swiftly. （议论文·成长智慧）

synonyms.example: "Everyone makes mistakes," his grandmother said gently, wiping the flour from his cheek. （读后续写·温情对话）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：mistake 最常用最口语，泛指因判断/理解不当造成的各种错误，搭配 make a mistake；error 更正式，多用于技术、计算、书面语和严肃语境，且是 in error / trial and error 等固定短语的唯一用词。

synonyms.example: It was my fault that we missed the train, and I apologized at once. （读后续写·主动担责）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：fault 侧重“过错、该负的责任”(It's my fault) 或“性格缺点/机器故障”；error 侧重“具体做错的一处”，不强调责任归属。

synonyms.example: Publishing the figures without checking them was a costly blunder. （议论文·失误分析）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：blunder 指因粗心或愚蠢造成的严重、明显的错误，含贬义，语气比 error 更重。

synonyms.example: A single flaw in the design brought the entire bridge project to a halt. （议论文·工程反思）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：flaw 指内在的缺陷、不完美之处（性格、设计、计划），并非临时犯的“错”，与 error 侧重不同。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·error 固定搭配群
advancedExpressions.expression: trial and error（反复试验）；in error（错误地）；make an error（犯错）；the error of one's ways（错误行径）；margin of error（误差范围）；human error（人为失误）
advancedExpressions.example: Learning through trial and error, he was quick to spot any error and to admit the error of his ways. （一句串起 trial and error / spot an error / the error of one's ways）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“错误”(可替换需辨语体)
advancedExpressions.expression: error ≈ mistake ≈ fault ≈ blunder（“做错之处”功能上可替换，语体与轻重不同：blunder 最重，error 正式，mistake 通用，fault 含责任）
advancedExpressions.example: It was a careless mistake / error / blunder that cost us the match. （三词在此句可替换，语气递重）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·词根 err- + 后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: err(动词) + -or → error(名词)；err + -oneous → erroneous(形容词)；err + -antly → errant
advancedExpressions.example: To err is to make an error; an erroneous belief is simply one built on such errors. （用同根词链条互相印证）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·可数名词 error 与谚语
advancedExpressions.expression: error 为可数名词，须 an error / errors；谚语 To err is human (, to forgive divine).
advancedExpressions.example: To err is human; what matters is the courage to correct each error we make. （用谚语开篇，提升议论文立意）

advancedExpressions.expression: one small error was all it took to ...
advancedExpressions.example: One small error was all it took to unravel months of painstaking work, and in that instant the laboratory fell utterly silent. （名词短语强调+in that instant 定格画面，制造转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: I hope you won't mind my pointing out a minor error in ...
advancedExpressions.example: I hope you won't mind my pointing out a minor error in the poster: the date of the concert seems to have been printed incorrectly. （委婉语气+动名词复合结构，礼貌得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: errors are not to be feared but to be embraced as ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the pursuit of truth, errors are not to be feared but to be embraced as stepping stones toward deeper understanding. （否定并列+隐喻(stepping stones)，提升立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He made a mistake and felt sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The realization that a single careless error had ruined the entire experiment washed over him like a cold wave, leaving him hollow and speechless before the ruined slides. （读后续写·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 同位语从句解释内容 + error 替换 mistake + 比喻(like a cold wave) + hollow and speechless 形容词并列刻画心理

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not be afraid of making errors.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is a truth too often forgotten that errors, far from being marks of shame, are in fact the indispensable footprints left along every road to genuine achievement. （议论文·观点升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a truth that... 强调句式 + far from being 让步插入 + 比喻(footprints) + indispensable 提升论证力度

classPractice.question: In November 1972, through trial and ____ (犯错，用名词), they successfully discovered qinghaosu.
classPractice.note: 考点：还原课文固定短语 trial and error “反复试验”，此处用名词 error。

classPractice.question: 用 error 的固定搭配填空：The letter was sent to the wrong address ____ ____, so it took a week to arrive.
classPractice.note: 考点：in error “错误地、由于失误”，副词性固定短语，无冠词。

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (error / mistake / fault)：To ____ is human, so don't blame yourself too harshly for one small ____; besides, it wasn't entirely your ____.
classPractice.note: 考点：谚语用动词 err；泛指“小错”口语用 mistake；“责任、过错”用 fault。

original_sentence: In November 1972, through trial and error, they successfully discovered qinghaosu—the most effective part of the qinghao extract.
readingExamples: In November 1972, through trial and error, they successfully discovered qinghaosu—the most effective part of the qinghao extract.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. by trying different methods and learning from the mistakes you make, rather than by following a fixed plan
(2) phr. describing a process of experimentation in which repeated attempts and failures gradually lead to a solution
(3) phr. (adverbial) in a way that relies on practical experimentation instead of theory alone

posExamples.sentence: Through trial and error, and countless nights bent over the flickering lamp, Tu's team finally coaxed the precious compound from the humble qinghao plant. （读后续写·科研攻坚）
I learned to cook not from any textbook but through trial and error, and I would be delighted to share these hard-won tips with our club members. （应用文·经验分享）
Human progress has, more often than not, been achieved through trial and error rather than through sudden flashes of genius. （议论文·科学精神）
The boy taught himself to ride entirely through trial and error, gathering bruises and courage in equal measure until, one golden evening, he finally sailed down the lane without falling. （读后续写·成长励志）

wordForms.noun: trial（尝试；试验；审判）+ error（错误）；the trial-and-error method（试错法）
wordForms.adjective: trial-and-error（连字符连写作定语，如 a trial-and-error approach 试错式的方法）
wordForms.other: 介词可用 through / by（through trial and error = by trial and error）；作定语连字符化 a trial-and-error process；核心义=不断试错、从失败中学习的方法论

idioms.translation: 反复试验，不断摸索（靠一次次尝试、从错误中学习，而非按固定方案）
idioms.example: There was no manual to follow; the young inventor built his machine purely by trial and error, learning from each failure. （无手册可循，全靠反复摸索）

collocations.phrase: through trial and error, sb. successfully discovered ...
collocations.translation: 通过反复试验，某人成功发现……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In November 1972, through trial and error, they successfully discovered qinghaosu—the most effective part of the qinghao extract. （课文原句词块·反复试验终获发现）

collocations.phrase: learn sth through trial and error
collocations.translation: 通过反复试验学会某事
collocations.example: She learned to tame the stubborn old computer through trial and error, one frustrating afternoon at a time. （读后续写·耐心毅力）

collocations.phrase: discover / find out through trial and error
collocations.example: The early aviators discovered the principles of flight largely through trial and error, often at great personal risk. （议论文·历史论证）

collocations.phrase: master a skill through trial and error
collocations.translation: 通过反复摸索掌握技能
collocations.example: No one handed him a formula; he mastered the craft of storytelling through trial and error over many quiet years. （读后续写·工匠精神）

collocations.phrase: a process of trial and error
collocations.example: Scientific breakthroughs are rarely instant; more often they are the fruit of a long process of trial and error. （议论文·科研规律）

collocations.translation: 凭反复试验（同义变体，介词换 by）
collocations.example: By trial and error she worked out the perfect recipe, adjusting the seasoning a pinch at a time. （读后续写·生活场景）

synonyms.example: By experimentation the students gradually pinned down which variable had spoiled their results. （议论文·科学方法）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、更学术，强调有意识、有设计的实验；through trial and error 更口语，强调“从一次次失败中摸索”的过程与试错性。

synonyms.synonym: by hit and miss / hit or miss
synonyms.translation: 碰运气式地，时好时坏地
synonyms.example: His early paintings were rather hit and miss, but each failure quietly sharpened his eye. （读后续写·艺术成长）
synonyms.usage: 偏口语，含“缺乏系统、靠碰运气”的意味，成功率不稳定；trial and error 更强调从错误中总结、逐步进步，带方法论色彩。

synonyms.example: Through repeated attempts and stubborn refusal to quit, she finally cracked the ancient code. （读后续写·坚持不懈）
synonyms.usage: 中性直白，突出“多次尝试”这一动作；trial and error 额外强调“从错误中吸取教训”的方法论内涵。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·trial / error 相关表达
advancedExpressions.expression: through/by trial and error（反复试验）；a process of trial and error（试错的过程）；the trial-and-error method（试错法）；learn the hard way（吃苦头才学会）
advancedExpressions.example: He learned the hard way, through a long process of trial and error, that shortcuts rarely last. （串联 learn the hard way 与 trial and error）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“反复试错摸索”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: through trial and error ≈ by experimentation ≈ through repeated attempts ≈ by hit and miss（“靠反复尝试摸索”功能上可替换，语体与严谨度不同）
advancedExpressions.example: She solved it through trial and error / through repeated attempts / by experimentation. （三种说法在此句功能可替换）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·名词并列成固定短语
advancedExpressions.expression: trial(尝试) and error(错误) 两个名词由 and 并列，凝固为不可拆的习语；作定语时连字符化 trial-and-error
advancedExpressions.example: A trial-and-error approach may look messy, yet it often uncovers what no theory predicted. （示范作定语的连字符写法）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·介词短语作状语
advancedExpressions.expression: through trial and error 为介词短语，在句中作方式状语，位置灵活（可置句首、句中或句末，句首后加逗号）
advancedExpressions.example: Through trial and error, they eventually succeeded. / They eventually succeeded through trial and error. （同一状语，句首/句末皆可）

advancedExpressions.expression: not by ... but through trial and error, sb. eventually ...
advancedExpressions.example: Not by luck but through trial and error, she eventually turned a string of failures into a hard-earned triumph. （对比结构 not...but... 突出方法与努力）

advancedExpressions.expression: having learned this through trial and error, I would advise ...
advancedExpressions.example: Having learned this the hard way through trial and error, I would strongly advise beginners to keep a detailed record of every attempt. （分词状语+建议句式，真诚可信）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being random, trial and error is itself a disciplined path to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being random guesswork, trial and error is itself a disciplined path to truth, demanding patience, precision and above all humility. （纠正误解+三名词排比，深化立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They found the answer by trying many times.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was not brilliance alone but sheer persistence — answer sought through trial and error over a thousand failed attempts — that finally lit the path before them. （读后续写·奋斗升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 强调句 It was not...but... + 插入语补充过程 + through trial and error 替换口语表达 + 隐喻(lit the path)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Science develops through trial and error.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every landmark in the history of science, from the humble candle to the space station, bears silent witness to a simple truth: knowledge advances through trial and error, one corrected mistake at a time. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 举例范围(from...to...)增强气势 + bears witness to 拟人 + 冒号引出论点 + one...at a time 收束有力

classPractice.question: 1972年11月，通过反复试验，他们成功发现了青蒿素。(trial and error) In November 1972, ____ ____ ____ ____, they successfully discovered qinghaosu.
classPractice.note: 考点：还原课文原句状语 through trial and error “通过反复试验”，介词 through 引导方式状语。

classPractice.question: The boy taught himself to ride entirely through trial and ____ , gathering bruises and courage in equal measure.
classPractice.note: 考点：固定习语 trial and error 中并列名词 error，不可换成 mistake。

classPractice.question: She worked out the recipe by making many attempts and learning from her failures. → She worked out the recipe ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.answer: through trial and error / by trial and error
classPractice.note: 考点：用习语 trial and error 概括“反复尝试并从失败中学习”，介词 through 或 by 均可。

translation: 智慧，知识，学问；才智；明智
original_sentence: Perhaps the next generation of scientists, drawing on the wisdom of traditional Chinese medicine, will indeed discover more medicines beneficial to global health care.
readingExamples: Perhaps the next generation of scientists, drawing on the wisdom of traditional Chinese medicine, will indeed discover more medicines beneficial to global health care.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the ability to make good judgements and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have
(2) n. the body of knowledge and experience that develops within a specified society or period
(3) n. the quality of being sensible and showing good judgement
(4) n. wise sayings or teachings considered as a whole

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常带 conventional / received）（未经检验的）公认看法、传统观念
uncommonMeanings.example: Conventional wisdom held that the marshland was worthless, yet the stubborn old farmer saw in it a hidden promise no one else could. （读后续写·独立思考）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （the wisdom of doing sth）做某事是否明智、明智之处（常用于质疑某决定）
uncommonMeanings.example: The board openly questioned the wisdom of investing everything in a single risky project. （议论文·决策反思）

posExamples.sentence: Drawing on the wisdom of her late grandmother, the girl brewed the bitter herbs exactly as she had been taught, and slowly the fever began to fade. （读后续写·传统智慧）
I sincerely hope that, guided by the wisdom of our teachers, we can turn this small reading club into a source of lifelong inspiration. （应用文·倡议书）
True wisdom lies not in the accumulation of facts, but in knowing how to apply knowledge with compassion and restraint. （议论文·知识与智慧）
Only in the quiet years of old age did he come to appreciate the wisdom his father had tried, in vain, to pass on to him as a headstrong boy. （读后续写·代际感悟）

wordForms.noun: wisdom（智慧，不可数）；wisdom tooth（智齿，可数）
wordForms.other: 形容词 wise + 名词后缀 -dom(状态、领域，同 freedom, kingdom) → wisdom；反义 folly/foolishness（愚蠢）、unwise（不明智的）；固定 words of wisdom（至理名言）、conventional wisdom（传统观念）、wisdom tooth（智齿）

idioms.example: Received wisdom warned against planting in such poor soil, yet her tiny garden bloomed against all odds. （议论文·打破常规）

idioms.translation: 凭某人的（无上）智慧（常带反讽）
idioms.example: The committee, in its infinite wisdom, scheduled the outdoor concert on the rainiest day of the year. （读后续写·反讽幽默）
Bound in that dusty little book lay the wisdom of the ages, waiting patiently for a curious mind to set it free. （读后续写·阅读感悟）

collocations.example: Perhaps the next generation of scientists, drawing on the wisdom of traditional Chinese medicine, will discover more medicines. 借鉴中医的智慧……（课件·Reading原句）
The singer drew on her own experiences to compose a new song, which instantly became a hit. 利用自己的个人经历……（课件·draw on 利用）
Drawing on her own experiences of hardship, she wrote a novel that moved readers to tears. （课件·draw on one's experiences）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（时光、季节）渐渐过去，荏苒
collocations.example: Night was drawing on, and one by one the windows of the village lit up against the dusk. 夜色渐深……（课件·draw on 时光渐渐过去）
She drew out a crumpled note from her pocket and read it once more. （课件·draw 短语·提取）
The committee drew up a detailed plan before the campaign began. （课件·draw 短语·拟定起草）
A sudden splash drew everyone's attention to the far side of the pond. （课件·draw 短语·使注意）
From these facts we can safely draw a conclusion that hard work matters. （课件·draw 短语·下结论）

collocations.phrase: draw to a close / an end
collocations.example: As the ceremony drew to a close, a warm round of applause filled the hall. （课件·draw 短语·结束）
As the exam drew near, the library grew quieter with each passing day. （课件·draw 短语·靠近）

collocations.phrase: draw a comparison between A and B
collocations.translation: 【课件】在 A 和 B 之间进行比较
collocations.example: The writer draws a comparison between city life and life in the mountains. （课件·draw 短语·比较）
Before the exam, our head teacher offered a few quiet words of wisdom that steadied every nervous heart in the room. （读后续写·师生情）

collocations.translation: 传统观念，公认的看法（常未经检验）
collocations.example: Conventional wisdom said the marshland was worthless, yet the old farmer saw hidden promise in it. （15词·打破成见）
One does not gain wisdom merely by growing older, but by reflecting honestly on all that one has lived through. （议论文·成长哲思）
The documentary reveals how ancient wisdom about the land still guides modern farmers in these remote valleys. （议论文·传统价值）

collocations.phrase: have the wisdom to do sth
collocations.example: She had the wisdom to walk away before a small quarrel grew into a lasting wound. （读后续写·人物品格）
Faced with the flood, the villagers pooled their collective wisdom and built the dyke in a single night. （读后续写·团结互助）
The book is full of practical wisdom drawn from decades of hard rural life. （应用文·书评推荐）
Many later questioned the wisdom of expanding so rapidly without a clear plan. （议论文·决策反思）

synonyms.example: Her essay showed a rare insight into the loneliness hidden behind city crowds. （议论文·社会观察）
synonyms.usage: 侧重深刻透彻地看清事物本质的能力，是“看得深”，常搭配 insight into sth；wisdom 更侧重善于判断、明智处世，是“想得对、做得好”，为不可数抽象名词。

synonyms.example: It was prudence, not fear, that made the captain wait for the storm to pass. （读后续写·沉稳性格）
synonyms.usage: 特指在行动前谨慎权衡、避免风险的明智，范围比 wisdom 窄；wisdom 涵盖更广的 judgment 与人生智慧。

synonyms.example: The old chief was famed throughout the region for his sagacity in settling disputes. （读后续写·长者形象）
synonyms.usage: 非常正式、书面化，形容敏锐精明的判断力，多用于描写德高望重之人；日常写作用 wisdom 更自然。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·draw 短语群（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】draw on the wisdom of（借鉴……的智慧）；draw on one's experiences（利用经历）；draw out（提取）；draw up（拟定，起草）；draw one's attention（使某人注意）；draw a conclusion（下结论）；draw to a close/an end（结束）；draw near/close（靠近）；draw a comparison between A and B（在 A、B 间比较）
advancedExpressions.example: Drawing on the wisdom of the elders, the committee drew up a plan, drew a conclusion, and, as the meeting drew to a close, drew everyone's attention to the next step. （一句串起 draw on / draw up / draw a conclusion / draw to a close / draw one's attention）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·wisdom 固定搭配群
advancedExpressions.expression: draw on the wisdom of（借鉴……的智慧）；words of wisdom（至理名言）；conventional/received wisdom（传统观念）；the wisdom of doing sth（做某事的明智）；have the wisdom to do sth（有智慧做某事）
advancedExpressions.example: Drawing on the wisdom of his elders, he had the wisdom to question the conventional wisdom of his age. （一句串起 draw on / have the wisdom to do / conventional wisdom）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“智慧/明智”(可替换需辨语境)
advancedExpressions.expression: wisdom ≈ insight ≈ prudence ≈ sagacity（“明智的判断力”功能上相近，具体色彩不同：insight 看得深，prudence 重审慎，sagacity 极正式）
advancedExpressions.example: The old teacher was admired for his wisdom / insight / sagacity. （三词在此句功能相近可替换，语体递升）

advancedExpressions.expression: wise(形容词) + -dom(表状态/领域) → wisdom(名词)；同类 free → freedom, king → kingdom, bore → boredom
advancedExpressions.example: Just as freedom is the state of being free, wisdom is the state of being wise. （用 -dom 家族类推记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·不可数名词 wisdom
advancedExpressions.expression: wisdom 表“智慧”时为不可数名词，不加 -s、不加 a；但 wisdom tooth（智齿）可数，复数 wisdom teeth
advancedExpressions.example: Wisdom is not measured in years, though a wisdom tooth may remind us how the years pass. （对照抽象不可数与具体可数用法）

advancedExpressions.expression: only with the passing of years did sb. grasp the wisdom of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only with the passing of years did she grasp the wisdom of her mother's quiet patience, a lesson no classroom could ever have taught. （倒装+定语从句，续写结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us draw on the collective wisdom of ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us draw on the collective wisdom of every classmate to make this campus greener, friendlier and truly our own. （祈使句号召+三形容词排比，富有感染力）

advancedExpressions.expression: knowledge tells us ..., but it is wisdom that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Knowledge tells us that a tomato is a fruit, but it is wisdom that keeps us from putting it in a fruit salad. （对比句式，机智点明知识与智慧之别）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old man was wise and gave good advice.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In the old man's weathered eyes shone a quiet wisdom, and every word he spoke seemed to unravel the knots that had long tangled her troubled heart. （读后续写·人物刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 倒装(In...shone) + wisdom 名词化提升 + 比喻(unravel the knots) + weathered/quiet 形容词渲染沧桑感

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should learn from traditional wisdom.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than dismissing the past as outdated, we would do well to draw on the wisdom of our ancestors, for buried within their time-honoured traditions often lie answers to the very questions that baffle us today. （议论文·文化传承）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than 让步开头 + would do well to 委婉建议 + for 引原因 + 倒装(buried...lie) 增强文采

classPractice.question: Perhaps the next generation of scientists, drawing on the ____ (wise) of traditional Chinese medicine, will discover more medicines.
classPractice.note: 考点：draw on the wisdom of 固定搭配，形容词 wise 转不可数名词 wisdom；还原课文原句。

classPractice.question: 用 wisdom 的固定搭配填空：Many people simply accept ____ ____ without ever asking whether these long-held beliefs are actually true.
classPractice.note: 考点：conventional/received wisdom “传统观念、公认看法”，常暗含“未经检验”。

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (wisdom / wise / wisely)：Only a truly ____ leader has the ____ to listen; he chooses his words ____ and his silences even more so.
classPractice.note: 考点：形容词 wise 修饰 leader；the wisdom to do 用名词；修饰动词 chooses 用副词 wisely。

original_sentence: Perhaps the next generation of scientists, drawing on the wisdom of traditional Chinese medicine, will indeed discover more medicines beneficial to global health care.
readingExamples: Perhaps the next generation of scientists, drawing on the wisdom of traditional Chinese medicine, will indeed discover more medicines beneficial to global health care.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having a good or helpful effect; producing advantages
(2) adj. improving a situation or contributing to someone's well-being
(3) adj. (law) receiving or entitled to profits or advantages from something, though not the legal owner

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法律）有受益权的；享有实益的
uncommonMeanings.example: Though the mansion stood in his brother's name, the will made him the beneficial owner of every acre of the estate. （读后续写·家族遗产·法律纠葛）

posExamples.sentence: As she watched the frail patients regain their colour week by week, Tu felt certain that the medicine drawn from the humble plant would prove beneficial to millions across the world. （读后续写·科研使命）
I firmly believe that a weekly volunteer programme would be highly beneficial both to the elderly in our community and to us students ourselves. （应用文·倡议书）
Moderate exposure to challenge and even failure is, in the long run, far more beneficial to a child's growth than a life carefully shielded from every hardship. （议论文·挫折教育）
The morning walks she once resented turned out to be the most beneficial habit of her recovery, gently coaxing strength back into her weary limbs. （读后续写·康复历程）

wordForms.verb: benefit（v. 使受益；benefit from = 从……中获益）
wordForms.adjective: beneficial（有益的）/ beneficent（（正式）行善的，仁慈的）
wordForms.other: 词根 bene-(好，同 benefit, benevolent) + fic-(做) + -ial(形容词后缀) → beneficial“做好事的=有益的”；注意介词固定用 to（be beneficial to）；动词 benefit 双向：A benefits B（A使B受益）/ B benefits from A（B从A受益）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……有益（介词固定用 to）
collocations.example: The next generation of scientists will discover more medicines beneficial to global health care. 有益于全球医疗保健的药物。（课件·Reading原句）
Cycling is highly beneficial to health and the environment. 骑自行车对身体和环境大有裨益。（课件·highly beneficial to）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（v.）使某人/某事受益，对……有好处
collocations.example: The new policy will benefit thousands of families in the countryside. （课件·benefit sb/sth）

collocations.phrase: be of benefit to sb / sth
collocations.example: Regular reading is of great benefit to a growing mind. （课件·be of benefit to）
You can also go over the knowledge at the same time and you are sure to benefit from it. （课件·语法填空原句·benefit from）

collocations.phrase: for the benefit of sb / for sb's benefit
collocations.translation: 【课件】为了帮助某人，为了……的利益
collocations.example: For the benefit of your health, it is necessary that you should have enough sleep and rest. （课件·语法填空原句·for the benefit of）

collocations.phrase: medicines beneficial to global health care
collocations.translation: 有益于全球医疗保健的药物（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The next generation will discover more medicines beneficial to global health care. （课文原句词块·有益于全球医疗）
The exchange programme proved beneficial in ways none of us had foreseen, forging friendships that crossed every border. （读后续写·跨文化交流）

collocations.translation: 互利的 / 非常有益的
collocations.example: A partnership built on trust is mutually beneficial, allowing both sides to grow far beyond what either could achieve alone. （议论文·合作共赢）
Studies confirm that spending time in nature has a beneficial effect on our mental health. （议论文·身心健康）
A balanced diet and enough sleep are far more beneficial to your health than any expensive supplement. （应用文·健康建议）
Switching to public transport is one of the most environmentally beneficial choices an ordinary citizen can make. （议论文·环保）
Keeping a daily journal is a quietly beneficial practice that sharpens both memory and self-awareness. （应用文·经验分享）

synonyms.example: Choosing the coastal route proved advantageous, sparing the travellers the worst of the mountain storms. （读后续写·旅途抉择）
synonyms.usage: 侧重“带来优势、更占上风”，常涉及策略、竞争、位置，搭配 advantageous to/for；beneficial 更侧重“对健康/福祉产生好的效果”，固定搭配 beneficial to。

synonyms.example: With favourable weather at last, the climbers seized their only chance to reach the summit. （读后续写·探险）
synonyms.usage: 侧重“条件顺利、态度赞成”（天气、评价、形势）；beneficial 侧重“实实在在带来好处”，二者不可混用。

synonyms.example: The camp offered children a wholesome mix of fresh air, hard play and honest friendship. （应用文·活动推荐）
synonyms.usage: 偏重“（对身心、道德）健康有益、纯净”，多修饰食物、生活方式、娱乐；beneficial 适用范围更广更中性。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·without / but for 引导含蓄虚拟条件
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】Without / But for + 名词短语 = 含蓄条件（虚拟语气），可转换为 If ... had not ...；对过去用 might/would/should/could + have done，对现在用 might/would/should/could + do
advancedExpressions.example: Without her broad knowledge of both traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine, Tu might never have discovered qinghaosu. = If she had not had her broad knowledge of ..., Tu might never have discovered qinghaosu. 没有……屠呦呦也许永远也不会发现青蒿素。（课件·Reading原句·含蓄条件句）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·without / but for 含蓄虚拟条件·仿写（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件·仿写】Without + n., sb. could/would (have) done ...
advancedExpressions.example: Without your help, I could not have finished the task so smoothly. 没有你的帮助，我不可能如此顺利地完成这项任务。（课件·仿写·对过去虚拟）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·without / but for 含蓄虚拟条件·仿写（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件·仿写】Without + n., there could/would ... （对现在虚拟）
advancedExpressions.example: Without air and water, there could be no life on Earth. 没有空气和水，地球上就没有生命。（课件·仿写·对现在虚拟）

advancedExpressions.expression: be beneficial to sb（对某人有益）；benefit sb（使某人受益）；benefit from sth（从某事中获益）；for the benefit of（为了……的利益）；of benefit to（对……有益，同 beneficial to）
advancedExpressions.example: The reform, beneficial to everyone, will benefit the poor most, for they have the most to benefit from it. （一句串起 beneficial to / benefit sb / benefit from）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“有益的”(可替换需辨语境)
advancedExpressions.expression: beneficial ≈ advantageous ≈ of benefit（“带来好处的”功能上可替换）；beneficial to = good for = of benefit to
advancedExpressions.example: Exercise is beneficial to / good for / of benefit to your health. （三种说法在此句功能可替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: bene-(好) + fic-(做) + -ial → beneficial；同族 benefit, benefactor(恩人), benevolent(仁慈的), beneficiary(受益人)
advancedExpressions.example: A benevolent benefactor is one whose gifts prove beneficial to countless beneficiaries. （用 bene- 家族串联记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·介词固定用 to + 常作后置定语
advancedExpressions.expression: be beneficial TO sb/sth（不用 for）；作后置定语修饰名词：medicines beneficial to health = medicines that are beneficial to health
advancedExpressions.example: We seek a policy beneficial to all — that is, a policy which is beneficial to every citizen. （示范 beneficial to 作后置定语=定语从句）

advancedExpressions.expression: what had once seemed a burden turned out to be profoundly beneficial
advancedExpressions.example: What had once seemed a needless burden turned out to be profoundly beneficial, shaping her into someone she had never dreamed she could become. （对比反转+结果分词，续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: such a measure would be beneficial not only to ... but also to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Such a measure would be beneficial not only to the students who take part but also to the wider community we all call home. （not only...but also 递进，扩大意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: what is momentarily pleasant is not always beneficial, and vice versa
advancedExpressions.example: What is momentarily pleasant is not always beneficial, and what is beneficial is seldom without its hardships. （对偶句式，凸显辩证深度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise is good for us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere pastime, regular exercise is profoundly beneficial to both body and mind, quietly building the resilience we draw upon in our darkest hours. （议论文·健康论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being 让步开头纠正认知 + beneficial 替换 good + to both...and... 平衡结构 + 定语从句延展意义

sentenceUpgrade.original: The advice he gave me helped a lot.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The few plain words of advice he gave me that rainy afternoon proved more beneficial than a shelf of textbooks, guiding my hesitant steps for years to come. （读后续写·师恩感怀）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 具体化场景(that rainy afternoon) + proved beneficial 提升 + 比较(than a shelf of textbooks) + 分词状语延伸时间跨度

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·2021新高考I）
classPractice.question: Although popular beliefs regarding emotional intelligence run far ahead of what research can reasonably support, the overall effects of the publicity have been more ____ (benefit) than harmful.
classPractice.note: 课件原题（2021新高考I）：more ... than harmful 结构中需形容词，benefit → beneficial 有益的。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·2020江苏）
classPractice.question: If you see humor as an optional form of entertainment, you're missing some of its biggest ____ (benefit).
classPractice.note: 课件原题（2020江苏）：biggest 后接名词，benefit 用可数复数 benefits “好处、益处”。

classPractice.question: As a result, ____ the benefit of your health, it is necessary that you should have enough sleep and rest.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：for the benefit of sb/sth “为了……的利益/好处”，介词用 for。

classPractice.question: You can also go over the knowledge at the same time and you are sure to benefit ____ it.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：benefit from sth “从……中受益”，介词用 from。

classPractice.question: The next generation of scientists may discover more medicines ____ (benefit) to global health care.
classPractice.note: 考点：medicines 后需形容词 beneficial 作后置定语（=that are beneficial）；还原课文原句词块。

classPractice.question: 用正确介词填空：Regular exercise is highly beneficial ____ both body and mind.
classPractice.note: 考点：be beneficial to sb/sth 介词固定用 to，不能用 for。

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (beneficial / benefit / benefit from)：A partnership built on trust is mutually ____; it not only ____s both sides but also lets each ____ the other's strengths.
classPractice.note: 考点：形容词 beneficial 作表语；及物 benefit sb “使受益”；benefit from sth “从……获益”。

translation: 组织，实施；指挥；引导；举止
original_sentence: Their efforts to conduct research in both fields may finally pay off.
readingExamples: Their efforts to conduct research in both fields may finally pay off.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to organize and carry out a particular activity, especially in order to get information or prove facts
(2) vt. to lead or guide someone through or around a particular place
(3) vt. to stand in front of a group of musicians and direct their playing
(4) vt. to allow heat, electricity, or sound to travel along or through it
(5) n. the way someone behaves, especially in public or in their job

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 熟词僻义：行为，品行（正式书面，读作 /ˈkɒndʌkt/，重音移到前面）
uncommonMeanings.example: The headmaster praised her exemplary conduct throughout the crisis. （读后续写·人物品格）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 传导（热、电、声）
uncommonMeanings.example: Copper conducts electricity far better than iron. （读后续写·科学场景）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 指挥（乐队、合唱团）
uncommonMeanings.example: He waved his arms to conduct the school choir. （读后续写·音乐会）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 引导，带领（参观、穿过某地）
uncommonMeanings.example: A guide conducted the visitors through the old palace. （应用文·参观）

posExamples.sentence: With trembling hands the old professor conducted the final experiment of his life, and as the solution turned a triumphant blue, tears he could no longer hold back rolled down his cheeks. （读后续写·科研·毕生心血）
I am writing to inform you that our club plans to conduct a week-long survey on campus dining, and we sincerely hope every student will spare a few minutes to share honest opinions. （应用文·通知/倡议）

Before any sweeping reform is introduced, policymakers ought to conduct rigorous, large-scale research, for decisions built on guesswork rather than evidence are bound to collapse under real-world pressure. （议论文·决策与证据）
A leader is judged not by eloquent promises but by daily conduct, since the quiet consistency of one's actions speaks far louder than any speech ever could. （议论文·领导力）

wordForms.noun: conduct (行为) / conductor (指挥;导体;售票员) / conduction (传导)
wordForms.other: 重音移位辨析：动词 conduct 读 /kənˈdʌkt/（重音在后），名词 conduct 读 /ˈkɒndʌkt/（重音在前）——高考听力/朗读常考；conductor n. 售票员;乐队指挥;导体

idioms.example: Though only fifteen, she conducted herself with a grace and composure that put many adults in the room to shame. （读后续写·人物修养）

collocations.phrase: conduct an experiment / a survey / research
collocations.translation: 【课件】做实验 / 进行调查 / 开展研究
collocations.example: Their efforts to conduct research in both fields may finally pay off. 他们在两个领域开展研究的努力……（课件·Reading原句）
The young maestro raised his baton to conduct the orchestra. （课件·指挥义）
Though only fifteen, she conducted herself with a grace that put many adults to shame. （课件·举止义）
Every student is supposed to obey the school's code of conduct. 每位学生都应该遵守学校的行为准则。（课件·code of conduct）

collocations.translation: 开展研究（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Their efforts to conduct research in both fields may finally pay off. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: conduct research / a study / an experiment
collocations.example: The two teams joined forces to conduct research into a rare disease. （读后续写·科研合作）

collocations.phrase: conduct a survey / an investigation / a poll
collocations.example: Our student union conducted a survey on weekend habits. （应用文·调查报告）
The reporter conducted a heartfelt interview with the firefighter. （读后续写·人物访谈）

Metals conduct heat quickly, so the spoon soon grew too hot. （读后续写·科学）

His disgraceful conduct at the ceremony left the team red-faced. （读后续写·冲突场景）
She conducted herself with grace throughout the whole crisis. （读后续写·修养）
The young maestro raised his baton to conduct the orchestra. （读后续写·音乐会）

synonyms.example: The researchers carried out a series of trials before daring to announce their breakthrough. （议论文·科研严谨）
synonyms.usage: 口语和书面通用,泛指落实计划/命令/实验;conduct 更正式,尤指有组织的研究、调查、活动

synonyms.example: The surgeon performed the delicate operation with a steadiness that amazed everyone in the room. （读后续写·手术场景）
synonyms.usage: 侧重完成某项(常需技巧的)任务/表演/手术;conduct 侧重组织并主导整个过程

synonyms.example: Her calm behaviour during the emergency reassured the frightened children. （读后续写·危机场景）
synonyms.usage: behaviour 是日常常用词,涵盖一切表现;conduct 作名词更正式,多指公开/职业场合的品行

advancedExpressions.expression: conduct research / a survey / an experiment / an interview | conduct oneself well | a code of conduct
advancedExpressions.example: Their efforts to conduct research in both fields may finally pay off; how they conduct themselves under pressure follows a strict code of conduct. （课文原句词块串联）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·进行/开展（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: conduct = carry out = perform = undertake（+ research / a study / an experiment）
advancedExpressions.example: The team decided to conduct / carry out / undertake a large-scale study on sleep. （四词可互换，conduct 与 carry out 最正式常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: con-(共同)+ duct(引导，来自拉丁 ducere 引导) → conduct 引导→进行；同根 produce / reduce / introduce / educate 都含 duc-
advancedExpressions.example: Words like conduct, produce and introduce all share the Latin root 'duct/duc' meaning 'to lead'. （构词法记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·conduct research 后接研究领域
advancedExpressions.expression: conduct research into / on sth（研究某课题）
advancedExpressions.example: Scientists are conducting research into new cures for cancer. （into/on 引出研究对象）

advancedExpressions.expression: as sb. conducted ..., every ... seemed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the boy conducted the imaginary orchestra with a pencil, every wave of his arm seemed to summon a music only he could hear. （伴随状语+夸张,画面生动）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are planning to conduct ..., and we would be grateful if ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are planning to conduct a charity book sale next weekend, and we would be grateful if you could donate the books gathering dust on your shelves. （通知信礼貌请求）

advancedExpressions.expression: how one conducts oneself in ... reveals ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: The scientist did an experiment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Hunched over the flickering lamp long after midnight, the scientist conducted yet another experiment, refusing to surrender to the string of failures that had piled up like fallen leaves outside his window. （读后续写·环境+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作状语(Hunched over...)营造画面 + 比喻(piled up like fallen leaves) + 时间状语烘托坚持

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should behave well.

classPractice.question: 每位学生都应该遵守学校的行为准则。Every student is supposed to obey the school's ____________.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：code of conduct “行为准则”，conduct 此处为名词，不可数无复数。

classPractice.question: Their efforts to ____ (conduct) research in both fields may finally pay off.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；to 后接动词原形 conduct research 开展研究。

classPractice.note: 两空均为名词 conduct 行为/品行；code of conduct 行为准则，不可数无复数。

original_sentence: A good example to illustrate this point is the discovery of qinghaosu in 1972.
readingExamples: A good example to illustrate this point is the discovery of qinghaosu in 1972.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make the meaning of something clearer by giving examples
(2) vt. to show that something is true or that a fact exists
(3) vt. to draw pictures, diagrams, or photographs for a book, article, etc.
(4) vt. to explain or make something clear, especially by using stories or comparisons

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】说明，解释（= explain）
uncommonMeanings.example: Statistics and graphs may help you better illustrate your point. 图表和数据可以帮助你更好地说明你的观点。（课件·illustrate = explain）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 给(书籍等)加插图，配图
uncommonMeanings.example: The old man had spent forty quiet years illustrating fairy tales. （读后续写·匠人一生）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用事实/例子）表明……是真的，证实
uncommonMeanings.example: The rise and fall of empires illustrates that no power lasts forever. （议论文·历史论证）

posExamples.sentence: To illustrate just how far she had come, the coach pinned her very first, shaky drawing beside the award-winning portrait — and the whole classroom fell silent with wonder. （读后续写·成长对比）
In this report I will use two real cases from our school to illustrate why a longer lunch break would benefit both students' health and their afternoon performance. （应用文·调查报告）
The rise and fall of countless empires vividly illustrates a timeless truth: no power, however mighty, can endure once it loses the trust of its people. （议论文·历史论证）
A single act of kindness on that rainy platform illustrated, better than any lecture ever could, what it truly means to care for a stranger. （读后续写·主题升华）

wordForms.noun: illustration (说明;例证;插图) / illustrator (插图画家)
wordForms.other: 名词 illustration 一词两义：既指'插图/图例'也指'例证/说明'；by way of illustration 作为例证

collocations.translation: 【课件】说明一个观点（= explain 说明、解释）
collocations.example: A good example to illustrate this point is the discovery of qinghaosu in 1972. 说明这一点的一个很好的例子……（课件·Reading原句）
Statistics and graphs may help you better illustrate your point. 图表和数据可以帮助你更好地说明你的观点。（课件·illustrate=explain）
He gave his little sister an illustrated book of fairy tales for her birthday. （课件·加插图义）
His lecture was illustrated with photos taken during the expedition. 他在演讲中使用了探险时拍摄的照片。（课件·be illustrated with）

collocations.phrase: a good example to illustrate this point
collocations.translation: 说明这一点的好例子（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: A good example to illustrate this point is the discovery of qinghaosu in 1972. （课文原句）
To illustrate his point, the teacher told a simple story. （议论文·举例论证）
This case clearly illustrates that hard work eventually pays off. （议论文·论点句）

collocations.phrase: illustrate the importance / value of sth
collocations.example: This experience illustrates the value of never giving up. （读后续写·感悟句）
As the survey results illustrate, most students long to read for pleasure. （应用文·报告）
The children's book was beautifully illustrated in gold. （读后续写·细节描写）

collocations.phrase: illustrate sth with examples / a diagram

Her success serves to illustrate that opportunity favours the prepared. （议论文·论点句）
The photograph vividly illustrated the flood's devastation. （读后续写·灾难场景）

synonyms.example: A good example to illustrate (= explain) this point is the discovery of qinghaosu. （课件明确 illustrate a point = explain）
synonyms.usage: 课件指出 illustrate 说明观点时约等于 explain；区别在于 illustrate 常借助具体例子/图示把观点讲清楚，explain 更泛指把道理讲明白。

synonyms.example: Her calm response demonstrated a maturity well beyond her years. （读后续写·人物刻画）
synonyms.usage: 侧重通过行动/证据清楚地证明某事为真;illustrate 更常指用具体例子把抽象观点讲清楚

synonyms.example: Let me clarify the rules before the competition begins so that no one feels confused. （应用文·说明）
synonyms.usage: 侧重消除误解、把模糊的东西讲明白;illustrate 强调借助例子/图示使人理解

synonyms.example: This selfless act exemplifies the very spirit our volunteer team stands for. （议论文·典范）
synonyms.usage: 更书面,指某事物本身就是某品质/道理的典型代表;illustrate 更主动,指有意举例说明

advancedExpressions.expression: a good example to illustrate this point | illustrate that ... | as ... illustrates | serve to illustrate
advancedExpressions.example: A good example to illustrate this point is the discovery of qinghaosu in 1972, which illustrates that great science often blends tradition and modern research. （课文原句词块+that从句）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·举例说明（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: illustrate = demonstrate = exemplify = clarify（说明/例证一个观点，语域相近可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: To illustrate / demonstrate / exemplify this point, allow me to cite a real case. （三词均可举例说明，clarify 侧重'澄清'）

advancedExpressions.expression: il-(=in 使)+ lustr(光，照亮)+ -ate(动词) → 使…被照亮→阐明；名词加 -ion(illustration)、施动者加 -or(illustrator)
advancedExpressions.example: illustrate → illustration → illustrator: the same lustr- root means 'to light up / make clear'. （构词法记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·illustrate 接 that 从句 vs 接名词
advancedExpressions.expression: illustrate + that 从句（说明……）/ illustrate + n.（举例说明某事物）

advancedExpressions.expression: what ... did that day illustrated, more powerfully than words, ...

advancedExpressions.expression: to illustrate this, I would like to cite ...

advancedExpressions.expression: a striking example that perfectly illustrates ... is ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: This story shows that hard work pays off.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: To illustrate...不定式作目的状语开头 + allow me to委婉正式 + draw upon a real case提升表达档次

original_sentence: Penicillin is widely considered to be one of the most important medical discoveries in history, but it was not what Alexander Fleming was looking for when he found it in September 1928.
readingExamples: Penicillin is widely considered to be one of the most important medical discoveries in history, but it was not what Alexander Fleming was looking for when he found it in September 1928.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a substance used as a medicine to kill bacteria and cure infections, originally obtained from a type of mould
(2) n. one of the first and most important antibiotics, discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928

posExamples.sentence: As the nurse pressed the needle in, the doctor explained that a small dose of penicillin was all that stood between the feverish child and a far darker fate. （读后续写·医院·生死时刻）
In my presentation I will explain how the accidental discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives and forever changed the course of modern medicine. （应用文·演讲稿）
The story of penicillin reminds us that world-changing breakthroughs often spring not from careful planning but from a curious mind alert to the unexpected. （议论文·科学与偶然）

wordForms.noun: penicillin (青霉素，专有名词，不可数)

definitionEn:

collocations.translation: 【课件】偶然，意外地（三者同义可换）
collocations.example: One might think Fleming discovered penicillin by accident, but actually this is far from the truth. （课件原句·偶然发现青霉素）

collocations.translation: 【课件】事实远非如此，绝非真相
collocations.example: One might think Fleming discovered penicillin by accident, but actually this is far from the truth. His account of the accident was far from the truth. （课件原句·事实远非如此）

collocations.phrase: far from + adj. / n. / v-ing (= anything but)
collocations.example: Computers, far from destroying jobs, can create employment. （课件原句·计算机远非破坏就业，反而创造就业）
It is no accident that online courses have grown rapidly in recent months. （课件原句·并非偶然）
Leaving the door unlocked when I was out was a pure accident. （课件原句·纯属意外）

collocations.translation: 偶然发现……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: One might think Fleming discovered penicillin by accident, but actually this is far from the truth. （课文原句）
Quite by accident, she overheard the two teachers praising her essay, and a warm glow of pride spread across her face. （读后续写·心理描写）
The scientist admitted that the breakthrough had come purely by accident, yet he had spent years preparing his mind for such a moment. （议论文·科学发现）
Wandering off the main path, the hikers found a hidden valley by accident, its slopes ablaze with wildflowers. （读后续写·探险场景）
I met my old primary-school teacher by accident at the bookshop, and we chatted for hours as if no time had passed at all. （读后续写·重逢）

collocations.phrase: do sth by accident (not on purpose)
collocations.translation: 无意中做某事(并非故意)
collocations.example: I deleted the file by accident, not on purpose, and immediately did everything I could to recover it. （应用文·解释/道歉）

collocations.phrase: not by accident but by design
collocations.translation: 并非偶然，而是有意为之
collocations.example: Her success came not by accident but by design, the fruit of years of quiet, disciplined effort. （议论文·成功归因）

synonyms.example: By chance, they boarded the same train and were seated side by side. （读后续写·巧合）
synonyms.usage: 与 by accident 几乎同义可换用；by chance 语气最中性，纯强调'碰巧'；by accident 有时略带'非故意、意料之外'的意味。二者均为介词短语，多置于句末或句首

synonyms.example: He accidentally knocked over the ink bottle, staining the neatly written page. （读后续写·尴尬瞬间）
synonyms.usage: accidentally 是副词，直接修饰动词，位置灵活(动词前或句首)；by accident 是介词短语，多置于句末，语气侧重'偶然'这一状态

synonyms.example: I did not break it on purpose; it happened entirely by accident. （道歉/澄清）
synonyms.usage: on purpose 是 by accident 的反义短语，表'有意、故意'；写作中常用 not ... on purpose but by accident 或 by accident, not on purpose 形成对照，凸显无心之失

synonyms.example: She unintentionally hurt his feelings with a careless remark and regretted it at once. （读后续写·人际冲突）
synonyms.usage: unintentionally 特别强调'主观上并无此意图'，多用于为无心之失辩解；by accident 更笼统，可指任何偶然情况

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·far from + adj./n./v-ing（远非，= anything but）
advancedExpressions.expression: far from the truth 事实远非如此；far from + adj. / n. / v-ing 远非、根本不（= anything but）
advancedExpressions.example: This is far from the truth; computers, far from destroying jobs, can create employment. （课件·far from 三种搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·by accident = by chance = accidentally（偶然）
advancedExpressions.expression: by accident = by chance = accidentally（偶然地）；反义 on purpose / by design（故意地，有意为之）
advancedExpressions.example: He discovered it by accident (= by chance = accidentally), not on purpose. （课件·三者同义 + 反义对照）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·it is no accident that / a pure accident（accident 名词义）
advancedExpressions.expression: it is no accident that ...（……并非偶然）；a pure accident（纯属意外）
advancedExpressions.example: It is no accident that online courses have grown rapidly; but leaving the door unlocked was a pure accident. （课件·并非偶然 vs 纯属意外）

advancedExpressions.expression: It was (quite) by accident that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was quite by accident that I stumbled upon the truth, and in that instant everything I had believed came crashing down. （强调句凸显偶然，制造戏剧转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: I did it by accident and never meant to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please believe me — I broke the window by accident and never meant to cause you any trouble. （诚恳澄清无意冒犯）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... came not by accident but through ...
advancedExpressions.example: Their triumph came not by accident but through years of perseverance and unwavering faith in themselves. （否定偶然、突出努力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I found the letter by accident.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rummaging through the old wooden chest for something else entirely, I came upon the faded letter quite by accident, and my heart skipped a beat the moment I recognised the handwriting. （读后续写·意外发现）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语(Rummaging...)交代情境 + come upon 替代 find + quite by accident 强化偶然 + 心理反应(heart skipped a beat)增画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: The discovery was made by accident.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though the discovery appeared to be made by accident, it was in truth the reward of a mind long trained to notice what others overlooked. （议论文·科学论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Though 让步从句 + appear to 弱化'纯偶然' + in truth 引出真正原因 + 定语从句(a mind long trained to...)提升句式层次

classPractice.question: 他打算怎样做一点都不清楚。It is ____ ____ what he ____ ____ do. (clear; intend)
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】far from + adj. 远非、根本不（= anything but clear）；intend to do 打算做

classPractice.question: 计算机远非破坏就业，而是能创造就业。Computers, ____ ____ ____ jobs, can create employment. (far / destroy)
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】far from + v-ing 远非做……；destroy 用动名词 destroying

classPractice.question: 有人可能会认为弗莱明发现青霉素是偶然的，但事实远非如此。
classPractice.answer: One might think Fleming discovered penicillin by accident, but actually this is far from the truth.
classPractice.note: 【课件原句·翻译】by accident 偶然地；far from the truth 事实远非如此

classPractice.question: 他对这次事故的描述绝不是真相。His account of the accident was ____ ____ ____ ____. (truth)
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】far from the truth 绝不是真相、事实远非如此

classPractice.question: 小说的很多情节都是弗莱明偶然发现青霉素的翻版。One might think Fleming discovered penicillin ____ ____, but actually this is far from the truth.
classPractice.note: 课文原句短语 by accident 偶然地，= by chance，反义 on purpose

classPractice.question: 改写下句，意思不变：He met his old friend by accident at the airport. → He ____ met his old friend at the airport.
classPractice.note: by accident (介词短语) = accidentally (副词)，副词直接置于动词前

classPractice.question: 把下面的句子译成英语：对不起，我不是故意的，我完全是无意中把它打碎的。
classPractice.answer: I'm sorry, I didn't do it on purpose; I broke it entirely by accident. / Sorry, I broke it by accident, not on purpose.
classPractice.note: 考 by accident 与反义 on purpose 的对照使用

translation: 有才智的，聪明的；有智力的
original_sentence: He was intelligent and experienced enough to notice its potential, and his hard work and determination helped get its mass production started.
readingExamples: He was intelligent and experienced enough to notice its potential, and his hard work and determination helped get its mass production started.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having or showing a high level of mental ability; good at learning, understanding and thinking
(2) adj. (of a machine or device) able to store information and use it in a way similar to human thought
(3) adj. showing careful thought and good judgement

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (机器/系统)智能的，能自主处理信息的
uncommonMeanings.example: The intelligent lighting system dimmed the classroom lights the instant the projector flickered to life, as if the very building could anticipate our every need. （读后续写·科技校园）

posExamples.sentence: Behind those quiet, watchful eyes lay a remarkably intelligent mind, and the moment the boy spoke, the whole classroom fell silent, hanging on his every word. （读后续写·人物刻画）
We are looking for intelligent and hard-working volunteers who are eager to help younger students unlock their full learning potential. （应用文·招募/倡议）
It would be a mistake to assume that intelligent people never fail; on the contrary, it is often their willingness to learn from failure that sets them apart. （议论文·成功与智慧）
Though he was far from the most intelligent student in class, his sheer persistence eventually carried him past every rival who had once looked down on him. （读后续写·逆袭励志）

wordForms.noun: intelligence (智力，智慧；情报) — artificial intelligence 人工智能
wordForms.adjective: intelligent (聪明的) / intelligible (可理解的，易懂的)
wordForms.other: 辨析形近词：intelligent 聪明的 (指人/系统有智力) ≠ intelligible 可理解的 (指话语/文字清楚易懂)，如 a clear, intelligible explanation

collocations.phrase: intelligent (and experienced) enough to do sth
collocations.translation: 足够聪明（且老练）去做某事（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He was intelligent and experienced enough to notice its potential, and his hard work and determination helped get its mass production started. （课文原句）
As artificial intelligence grows ever more powerful, we must think carefully about how to use it wisely. （议论文·科技伦理）
The professor was highly intelligent, yet what impressed his students most was his boundless patience. （读后续写·人物）

collocations.translation: 有见地的猜测/问题/回答
collocations.example: Even when she was unsure, she managed to make an intelligent guess that revealed how carefully she had been thinking. （读后续写·课堂）
For centuries, humans have gazed at the stars, wondering whether intelligent life exists somewhere in the vast darkness. （议论文·科技/太空）
Choosing to apologise first was an intelligent decision that saved a friendship on the brink of collapse. （读后续写·人际）

collocations.phrase: intelligent and experienced enough to do
collocations.translation: 既聪明又老练，足以做某事
collocations.example: He was intelligent and experienced enough to sense the danger long before it revealed itself to the others. （读后续写·紧张情节）
Over a simple cup of tea, the two strangers fell into an intelligent conversation that lasted well past midnight. （读后续写·邂逅）
The intelligent use of limited resources allowed the small village school to give its pupils a first-class education. （议论文·教育资源）

synonyms.example: The clever boy quickly worked out a way to fix the leaking roof with nothing but an old raincoat and some string. （读后续写·机智应变）
synonyms.usage: clever 偏口语，强调机灵、反应快、点子多，有时略含'耍小聪明'的意味；intelligent 更正式，强调理解力和思考深度，褒义更纯。三者程度递进：clever/intelligent < brilliant

synonyms.example: The wise old fisherman knew that patience, not force, was the key to a good catch. （读后续写·长者形象）
synonyms.usage: wise 强调基于人生经验的判断力和明智，重'阅历与判断'，常形容长者、决定(a wise decision)；intelligent 强调天生或学习得来的智力，重'思维能力'。聪明未必明智：One can be intelligent without being wise.

synonyms.translation: 才华横溢的，绝顶聪明的
synonyms.example: Her brilliant solution left even the examiners speechless with admiration. （议论文·人物评价）
synonyms.usage: brilliant 语气最强，形容才华出众、令人惊叹；intelligent 只表示智力水平高，程度上不及 brilliant

advancedExpressions.expression: there was an unmistakable intelligence in sb.'s eyes / manner
advancedExpressions.example: There was an unmistakable intelligence in the boy's eyes, a quiet spark that hinted at thoughts far deeper than his years. （以眼神暗示才智，避免直白说 'he was clever'）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. is not only intelligent but also ...
advancedExpressions.example: I can assure you that Lucy is not only intelligent but also remarkably diligent, which makes her the ideal candidate for this scholarship. （推荐信中先智后勤，全面评价）

advancedExpressions.expression: being intelligent is one thing; ... is quite another
advancedExpressions.example: Being intelligent is one thing; putting that intelligence to good and moral use is quite another. （二分对比，凸显品格重于智力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was a very intelligent boy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath his shy, unassuming exterior hid a keenly intelligent boy whose sharp questions could catch even his teachers off guard. （读后续写·反差刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 外貌与内在反差(shy exterior vs keenly intelligent) + 倒装式描写(Beneath...hid) + 定语从句展现能力(whose sharp questions...)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Intelligent people can still fail.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would be naïve to believe that intelligence alone guarantees success, for even the most intelligent among us stumble when they lack the courage to persevere. （议论文·辩证论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would be naïve to believe... 提出待驳观点 + for 引出理由 + 最高级 the most intelligent among us 让步 + 强调恒心的重要

classPractice.question: He was ____ (intelligent) and experienced enough to notice the mould's potential.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：intelligent + enough to do 结构，enough 放在形容词之后

classPractice.question: With the rapid development of artificial ____ (intelligent), machines can now translate dozens of languages instantly.
classPractice.note: artificial intelligence 人工智能，此处需名词 intelligence；注意与形容词 intelligent 区分

classPractice.question: 用 intelligent / wise 填空：Though he is very ____, he is still too young to make a ____ decision about his whole future.
classPractice.note: intelligent 指智力高(天生/学习)；wise 指基于阅历的明智判断，a wise decision 更地道

translation: vt. 较喜欢；偏袒；有助于 | n. 帮助，好事；赞同；偏袒
original_sentence: As Louis Pasteur said, “Fortune favours the prepared mind.”
readingExamples: As Louis Pasteur said, “Fortune favours the prepared mind.”
definitionEn:
(1) n. a kind or helpful act that you do for someone
(2) n. approval, support or preference for someone or something
(3) vt. to prefer one person, group or possibility to another, often unfairly
(4) vt. to support or approve of something; to be advantageous to; to make something more likely to succeed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 帮助，善意的行为（可数，do sb a favour）
uncommonMeanings.example: Could you do me a favour and post this letter on your way home? （日常请求）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 赞成，支持；青睐（不可数，in favour of）
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole committee voted in favour of the new library plan. （表态支持）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 较喜欢，赞成（择优）
uncommonMeanings.example: Most teachers favour a method that encourages students to think for themselves. （议论文·观点）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 偏袒，厚此薄彼(不公平地偏爱)
uncommonMeanings.example: The children were quick to sense that their grandmother favoured the youngest, and a shadow of jealousy crept quietly into the once-happy household. （读后续写·家庭矛盾·偏心）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有利于，有助于(条件/形势对……有利)
uncommonMeanings.example: With a strong tailwind favouring them, the young rowers surged ahead, their oars slicing the water in perfect, tireless rhythm. （读后续写·比赛·天时地利）

posExamples.sentence: When the storm finally passed, the old man asked me for one last favour — to carry his grandson's kite to the top of the hill and let it fly free. （读后续写·温情/嘱托）
I would be extremely grateful if you could do me a favour by proofreading my application before I submit it next Monday. （应用文·请求信）
Most parents nowadays favour a balanced approach to education, one that nurtures character and creativity rather than test scores alone. （议论文·教育理念）
The proposal to plant more trees along the riverbank won the favour of nearly every resident at the community meeting. （应用文·倡议/报告）

wordForms.noun: favour (帮助；赞成) / favourite (最爱的人或物)
wordForms.adjective: favourable (有利的；赞成的) / favourite (最喜爱的)
wordForms.other: 拼写辨析：英式 favour / favourite / favourable，美式 favor / favorite / favorable（去掉 u）；高考写作两种拼法均可，但同一篇须统一

idioms.example: Could you do me a favour and keep an eye on my little brother while I fetch the doctor? （读后续写·请求帮助）
After a long debate, the whole class voted overwhelmingly in favour of holding the charity concert outdoors. （应用文·活动决议）
Once the star of the team, he suddenly found himself out of favour after a string of careless mistakes. （读后续写·处境转变）
As the final whistle approached, the odds seemed hopelessly against them, yet fate, at the last second, turned in their favour. （读后续写·逆转）

idioms.idiom: fortune favours the bold / the prepared mind
idioms.translation: 机遇偏爱勇敢者/有准备的头脑
idioms.example: As Pasteur reminded us, fortune favours the prepared mind, and it was Fleming's alertness that turned a mouldy dish into a medical miracle. （议论文·机遇与准备）

collocations.example: The policy seems to favour the graduates with experiences of studying abroad. （课件·这项政策似乎更偏向有留学经历的毕业生）

collocations.translation: 【课件】较喜欢，倾向于（某种做法）
collocations.example: I favour a quiet and peaceful life. （课件·我较喜欢安静平和的生活）

collocations.phrase: favour sth（有利于；help / provide suitable conditions）
collocations.translation: 【课件】有利于，有助于（条件对……有利）
collocations.example: The warm climate favours many types of tropical plants. （课件·温暖的气候对多种热带植物生长有利）
Could you do me a favour and tell Kelly I can't make it? （课件·完成句子·你帮个忙告诉Kelly说我来不了好吗）
He had helped me so often that I now owe him a favour I may never fully repay. （课件义·人情往来）
As an examiner, she showed no favour to any candidate. （课件·作为主考官，她对任何考生都不偏袒）
I am in favour of the proposal you put forward at the meeting. （课件·我赞成你在会上提出的建议）

collocations.phrase: in one's favour（= to one's advantage）
collocations.example: People are willing to make the effort, especially when the work is in their favour. （课件·当工作对自己有利时，人们尤其愿意付出努力）
It remains to be seen if the show will still find/win favour with a 1990s audience. （课件·这档节目能否仍受1990年代观众欢迎还有待观察）
The favourable economic conditions helped hundreds of small businesses survive the difficult year. （课件·favourable economic conditions 有利的经济环境）

collocations.phrase: leave / make a favourable impression on sb
collocations.example: A firm handshake and warm smile can make a favourable impression on an interviewer within seconds. （课件·favourable comments 好评 / 留下好印象）

collocations.translation: 机遇偏爱有准备的头脑（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: As Louis Pasteur said, "Fortune favours the prepared mind." （课文原句）
Could you do me a favour and keep an eye on my bag for a moment? （日常请求）
After a long debate, the class voted overwhelmingly in favour of holding the concert outdoors. （应用文·活动决议）

collocations.phrase: ask sb a favour / ask a favour of sb
collocations.example: May I ask you a small favour? I need someone to water my plants while I am away for the week. （应用文·请求信）
She had helped me through my darkest days, and I was determined to return the favour when misfortune struck her family. （读后续写·知恩图报）
His bold new design quickly found favour with the judges and went on to win the top prize. （读后续写·比赛成功）
Many young people today favour convenience over quality, a trend that worries a growing number of educators. （议论文·消费观）
Through years of honest dealing, the small shop gradually won the favour of the entire neighbourhood. （读后续写·口碑）
The headmaster looked on the students' recycling project with favour and pledged the school's full support. （应用文·校园活动）
Instead of currying favour with the manager, she quietly let her work speak for itself. （议论文·品格/为人）
A firm handshake and a warm smile can create a favourable impression within the very first seconds of a meeting. （应用文·面试建议）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】有利的、赞同的 / 不利的、否定的
synonyms.example: The critics' favourable comments delighted the young director, while a single unfavourable review could not dampen her joy. （课件·favourable comments 好评；opp. unfavourable）
synonyms.usage: 【课件】favour 的形容词：favourable 肯定的、赞同的、有利的，搭配 be favourable to sb/sth（对……有利）、favourable comments（好评）、favourable economic conditions（有利的经济环境）、leave/make a favourable impression on sb（留下好印象）；反义 unfavourable 不利的、否定的

synonyms.example: She preferred walking to school, savouring the quiet streets before the city fully awoke. （读后续写·日常/心境）
synonyms.usage: prefer 是最常用、最中性的'更喜欢'，后接 to do / doing / A to B；favour 作'偏爱'时更正式，且常暗含'偏袒不公'或'看好某方案'

synonyms.example: The majority of parents supported the school's decision to extend the reading hour. （应用文/议论文·表态）
synonyms.usage: support 强调实际的赞成与拥护(常涉行动、投票)；in favour of 表态度倾向，语气略正式，二者常可互换

synonyms.example: The new policy will benefit thousands of rural students who have long lacked quality resources. （议论文·政策评价）
synonyms.usage: benefit 明确表示'带来好处、使受益'，及物或不及物皆可；favour 作'有利于'时较文雅，多形容条件/形势对某方有利

advancedExpressions.expression: would you (be so kind as to) do me a favour and ...
advancedExpressions.example: 'Would you be so kind as to do me a favour,' the trembling old lady whispered, 'and help me find my way home?' （礼貌请求+人物处境，推进情节）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am firmly in favour of ... , for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am firmly in favour of setting up a school garden, for it would bring both joy and a sense of responsibility to every student. （明确立场+理由）

advancedExpressions.expression: while some favour ..., I would argue in favour of ...
advancedExpressions.example: While some favour strict rules to maintain order, I would argue in favour of trust, for freedom nurtures responsibility far better than fear ever could. （对比双方立场，亮明观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Can you help me?
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I hate to trouble you, but might I ask you a small favour — could you possibly lend me a hand carrying these boxes up the stairs? （读后续写·礼貌求助）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I hate to trouble you 铺垫歉意 + might I ask 委婉句式 + a small favour 弱化请求分量 + could you possibly 双重委婉，语气得体

sentenceUpgrade.original: Most people support this idea.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The overwhelming majority of residents came out firmly in favour of the proposal, convinced that a greener neighbourhood would benefit generations to come. （议论文/报告·表态）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: overwhelming majority 强化支持度 + come out in favour of 固定表态短语 + 分词状语(convinced that...)补充理由 + generations to come 升华意义

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·语境应用）
