advancedExpressions.expression: the moral choice / moral courage / moral support / a moral dilemma / the moral of the story / draw a moral from
advancedExpressions.example: Faced with a moral dilemma, he found the moral courage to choose rightly — the very moral of every good story. （形容词义"道德的"与名词义"寓意"一并掌握）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·道德的/正直的(adj.)
advancedExpressions.expression: moral / ethical / virtuous / righteous / upright
advancedExpressions.example: She led a moral / ethical / virtuous life, always doing right by others. （功能：形容人或行为"合乎道德"，据语域和情感替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: moral (adj./n.) → morally (adv.) → morality (n. 道德) → immoral (adj. 不道德的) → morals (n. pl. 品行)
advancedExpressions.example: It was morally wrong — indeed downright immoral — a clear failure of his morals and of common morality. （-ly 构副词，-ity 构抽象名词，im- 表否定，复数 morals 表品行）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·moral 名词义"寓意"
advancedExpressions.expression: the moral of the story is (that) ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moral of the story is that patience masters the sea. （moral 此处为可数名词"寓意/教训"，注意与形容词义区分）

advancedExpressions.expression: faced with a moral choice, sb. chose ...
advancedExpressions.example: Faced with a moral choice that most would have fled, he chose the harder, honest path — and slept soundly for the first time in weeks. （Faced with 过去分词短语作状语 + 破折号引出内心平静，凸显抉择的分量）

advancedExpressions.expression: we have a moral obligation to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the fortunate few, we have a moral obligation to lend our hands to those the world has left behind. （we have a moral obligation to 责任句式 + those...left behind 指代弱势群体，倡议书升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: knowledge without moral guidance is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Knowledge without moral guidance is a ship without a rudder — powerful, yet perilously adrift. （比喻式论断 without...is a...without... + 破折号补充，深化'德才关系'的思辨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He made the right moral choice in the end.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In the end, though every easier road beckoned, he made the moral choice — quietly, without applause — and in that solitary act of conscience he became, at last, the man his father had always believed he could be. （读后续写·品格成型）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In the end 收束 + though 让步从句 + 破折号插入 quietly, without applause 强化无声的高尚 + in that...act 结果状语 + 定语从句 the man his father had believed 呼应成长主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students should learn to be good people, not just clever.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that the ultimate aim of education is not merely to sharpen the mind but to shape the moral character — for a brilliant intellect untempered by conscience is a gift the world can ill afford. （议论文·教育目的）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + not merely...but 递进对比 + sharpen/shape 动词押头韵 + for 引导原因 + untempered by conscience 过去分词后置定语 + can ill afford 高级表达收尾

classPractice.question: It is also to the credit of ____ ____ ____ (道德抉择) which led us to good work.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点：moral 作形容词修饰 choice；后接 which 引导定语从句。

classPractice.question: 这个故事的寓意是善良终有回报。(用 the moral of the story)
classPractice.answer: The moral of the story is that kindness is always rewarded.
classPractice.note: moral 作可数名词表"寓意、教训"；the moral of the story 为固定表达。

classPractice.question: Even from afar, her parents' messages of ____ (moral) support gave her the strength to carry on.
classPractice.note: moral support = 精神支持（非物质），moral 此处为形容词；不要误填 morally。

original_sentence: Scientific knowledge is an enabling power to do either good or bad—but it does not carry instructions on how to apply it.
readingExamples: Scientific knowledge is an enabling power to do either good or bad—but it does not carry instructions on how to apply it.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to put something to practical use; to make use of a rule, method, idea, etc. in a particular situation
(2) vi. to make a formal request, usually in writing, for a job, place, permission, etc.
(3) vt. to spread or rub a substance such as cream, paint or medicine onto a surface
(4) vi. to be relevant to or affect a particular person, group or situation

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 全神贯注于，专心致力于（apply oneself to）
uncommonMeanings.example: Once the coach's words sank in, the boy applied himself to training with a fierceness no one had seen before, arriving before dawn and leaving long after the floodlights dimmed. （读后续写·人物成长·勤奋觉醒）

posExamples.sentence: Trembling yet determined, she applied everything her grandmother had taught her about patience, and the wilting seedlings in the schoolyard slowly lifted their heads toward the morning sun. （读后续写·坚持与希望）

I am writing to apply for the position of student volunteer at the coming International Book Fair, as I am confident that my fluent English and warm personality make me a suitable candidate. （应用文·申请信）
Knowledge that is never applied to real life remains as lifeless as words locked away in a dusty dictionary; only when we act upon what we learn does it acquire genuine value. （议论文·知行合一）
The same principle of mutual respect applies not only to friendships but to every relationship we build throughout our lives. （议论文·原则普适性）

wordForms.noun: application (申请/应用) / applicant (申请人) / appliance (器具)
wordForms.other: 同根词族：apply → application(n. 申请书/应用) → applicant(n. 申请人) → applicable(adj. 适用的)；注意 apply 变名词双写规则不涉及，但拼写为 appl-i-cation

collocations.example: He is eager to apply the technology to practical business problems. （课件原句·应用义）
In this way they can better apply theory to practice. （课件原句·应用义）
You have to apply to the U.S. embassy for a visa. （课件原句·申请义）
The nurse applied some medicine to her swollen arm. （课件原句·涂敷义）
What I said applies only to some of you. （课件原句·适用义）
Frank has applied himself to this task with considerable energy. （课件原句·致力于义）
We applied our minds to finding a solution to our problem. （课件原句·专心于义）

collocations.translation: 如何应用它（课文原句：知识不附带使用说明）
collocations.example: It does not carry instructions on how to apply it. （课文原句·节选）
Encouraged by his teacher, Tom summoned his courage to apply for the scholarship. （读后续写·勇气与机遇）
This rule applies to every member of our club without exception. （议论文·公平原则）
By applying what she had learned in physics to the paper bridge, Lucy watched it bear a full water bottle. （读后续写·学以致用）
If you apply yourself wholeheartedly to your studies now, closed doors will one day swing wide open. （应用文·鼓励信）

collocations.translation: 施加压力 / 涂抹药膏
collocations.example: The nurse gently applied pressure to the wound, murmuring words of comfort. （读后续写·救助场景）
Theories that sound flawless on paper must ultimately be applied in practice before we judge their worth. （议论文·理论与实践）
Our teacher applied a brand-new approach to grammar, turning dreary drills into a lively guessing game. （读后续写·课堂）
Those who wish to join the summer camp are kindly requested to apply online before month's end. （应用文·通知）

synonyms.example: The seasoned detective employed every trick of observation he possessed, and at last a tiny detail betrayed the truth. （读后续写·推理）
synonyms.usage: 侧重有意识地选用某种手段、技巧或人力，比 apply 更强调'调动使用'，也可指雇用

synonyms.translation: 利用（尤指有效利用现有资源）
synonyms.example: We should fully utilize the school library, a treasure house of knowledge that too many students walk past every day. （议论文·资源利用）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，强调把现有资源加以有效利用；apply 更侧重把规则/知识用于具体情境

synonyms.example: The doctor administered the medicine with steady hands, and within minutes the patient's breathing grew calmer. （读后续写·急救）
synonyms.usage: 在'涂/施用'义上更专业正式，多用于医疗语境，日常涂抹用 apply 即可

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·apply 四义与介词搭配(to/for/oneself to)
advancedExpressions.expression: apply sth to sth（应用/涂于）| apply to sb/sth for sth（向…申请…）| apply to sb/sth（适用于）| apply oneself/one's mind to（致力于）
advancedExpressions.example: He applied the theory to practice, applied to the embassy for a visa, and applied himself to the task — but the rule still applies to us all. （课件四义一次辨清，介词 to/for 是关键）

advancedExpressions.expression: apply for (申请) / apply to (适用于;向…申请) / apply sth to sth (把…应用/涂于) / apply oneself to (专注于) / apply online
advancedExpressions.example: He applied for a place, applied himself to preparation, and applied everything he had learned to the interview — the same effort should apply to us all. （四个高频义项与介词搭配一次辨清）

advancedExpressions.expression: apply / employ / utilize / use / put ... into practice
advancedExpressions.example: The detective applied / employed / utilized every trick of observation he possessed. （功能：表"运用手段、知识"，据语域替换；apply 侧重"用于具体情境"）

advancedExpressions.expression: apply (v.) → application (n.) → applicant (n. 申请人) → applicable (adj. 适用的) → appliance (n. 家用器具)
advancedExpressions.example: Every applicant must submit an application; the same rule is applicable to all. （-ation 构名词，-ant 构"人"，-able 构形容词，-ance 构"器具"）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·apply for vs apply to 辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: apply for + 想得到的东西 / apply to + 对象或范围
advancedExpressions.example: You apply for a job but apply to a company; and the rule applies to everyone. （for 后接"所求之物"，to 后接"申请对象"或"适用范围"）

advancedExpressions.expression: not until sb. applied ... did sb. truly understand ...
advancedExpressions.example: Not until she applied her grandmother's timeworn wisdom to her own troubles did she truly understand the quiet strength behind those simple words. （倒装强调+情感升华，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to apply for ..., convinced that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to apply for the post of campus guide, convinced that my passion for our school's history will make every visitor feel warmly welcomed. （申请信固定开篇，convinced 分词状语增强说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: knowledge is worthwhile only when it is applied to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Knowledge, however profound, is worthwhile only when it is applied to solving the real problems that press upon our society. （however 让步插入语+only when 强调条件，凸显知行合一）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He applied what he had learned and solved the problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Drawing on every scrap of knowledge he had painstakingly gathered over the long winter, he applied it with such precision that the once-impossible problem seemed to unravel of its own accord before his very eyes. （读后续写·智慧与努力）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Drawing on... 分词状语开头 + such...that 结果状语 + of its own accord 拟人化表达 + before his very eyes 画面感收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students should apply their knowledge to real life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore imperative that students learn to apply the theories confined within textbooks to the vivid, ever-changing world beyond the classroom walls. （议论文·知行合一）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is imperative that + 虚拟语气(动词原形) 强化建议力度 + confined within/beyond the classroom walls 空间对比意象

classPractice.type: 语境应用·用所给词的正确形式填空
classPractice.question: His ____ (apply) for membership of the organization was rejected.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】此处需名词作主语，apply → application 申请（书）；one's application for sth 对……的申请。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·用适当介词填空
classPractice.question: Please clean the wound with a clean cloth and then apply the medicine ____ it.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】apply sth to sth = 把……涂/敷到……；涂敷义固定用介词 to。

classPractice.type: 语境应用·用所给词的正确形式填空
classPractice.question: Later I decided to apply my previous experience to ____ (learn) how to read and write.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】apply sth to (doing) sth：此处 to 是介词，后接动名词 learning。

classPractice.question: Scientific knowledge does not carry instructions on ____ ____ ____ ____ (如何应用它).
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点："疑问词 + to do"结构 how to apply；apply 作及物动词"应用"。

classPractice.question: Tom decided to apply ____ (for / to) the scholarship, and the same deadline applies ____ (for / to) every candidate.
classPractice.note: apply for + 所求之物（奖学金）；apply to + 适用对象（每个人）。介词不同义不同。

classPractice.question: Only when knowledge is ____ (apply) to real life does it acquire genuine value.
classPractice.note: knowledge 与 apply 是被动关系，用被动语态 is applied；Only when 引导从句主句需部分倒装 does it acquire。

original_sentence: Such power has obvious value—even though the power may be negated by what one does with it.
readingExamples: Such power has obvious value—even though the power may be negated by what one does with it.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make something ineffective or of no value; to cancel out the effect of something
(2) vt. to state that something does not exist or is not true; to deny
(3) vt. (formal/logic) to prove or declare the opposite of a statement

posExamples.sentence: One careless word, hurled in a moment of anger, seemed to negate all the trust they had patiently built over the years, and silence settled heavily between them. （读后续写·友情裂痕）
We must ensure that a single act of vandalism does not negate the tireless efforts of the many volunteers who have devoted their weekends to beautifying our campus. （应用文·倡议书）
To ignore the wisdom of the past is to negate the very foundation upon which all human progress has been built. （议论文·尊重传统）
No amount of last-minute cramming can negate months of steady, disciplined study; there is simply no shortcut to lasting knowledge. （议论文·勤奋无捷径）

wordForms.other: negative 词族全家桶：negate(v.)→negation(n.)→negative(adj.)→negatively(adv.)；neg- 词根表"否定"，反义正面为 positive

collocations.translation: 【课件】使……失效；抵消……的作用（PPT义：to stop sth from having any effect）
collocations.example: Alcohol negates the effects of the drug. 酒精能使这种药物失效。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 被……抵消 / 使无效（课文原句：力量被使用它的方式抵消）
collocations.example: Such power has obvious value—even though the power may be negated by what one does with it. （课文原句）
A single failure does not negate the value of everything you have achieved. （读后续写·励志安慰）
Skipping breakfast can completely negate the effect of a good night's sleep. （议论文·健康作息）

collocations.translation: 使某人的努力付诸东流
collocations.example: She refused to let one poor result negate her efforts, reaching once more for her worn notes. （读后续写·不屈）
A single well-documented counterexample can negate an argument that has stood for decades. （议论文·批判性思维）

collocations.translation: 在很大程度上／彻底／实际上抵消
collocations.example: The convenience of fast food is largely negated by the harm it quietly inflicts on our health. （议论文·饮食利弊）

synonyms.example: His generous donation and his hurtful remark seemed to cancel each other out, leaving the crowd uncertain whether to praise or blame him. （读后续写·人物复杂性）
synonyms.usage: 口语和书面通用，强调两种力量相互抵消归零；negate 更正式，可单向使无效

synonyms.example: Constant criticism can quietly undermine a child's confidence until little remains of the bold spirit he was born with. （读后续写·成长创伤）
synonyms.usage: 侧重逐渐、暗中地削弱根基，是渐进过程；negate 强调结果上使无效或抵消

synonyms.example: One breach of the rules was enough to nullify the entire team's hard-won qualification. （议论文·规则的严肃性）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、偏法律/正式语境，指使某物正式失效；negate 应用面更广，含'否定'义

advancedExpressions.expression: negate the value / effect / benefits of / negate one's efforts / negate the argument / largely (completely) negate
advancedExpressions.example: One careless act can negate the value of years of effort and completely negate the benefits already gained. （negate + 抽象名词的高频搭配集合）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·抵消/使无效(vt.)
advancedExpressions.expression: negate / cancel out / nullify / undermine / undo
advancedExpressions.example: His rude remark seemed to negate / cancel out / undo all the goodwill he had built. （功能：表"使无效、抵消"，据语域替换；nullify 偏正式法律，undermine 强调渐进削弱）

advancedExpressions.expression: negate (v.) → negation (n. 否定) → negative (adj. 否定的/负面的) → negatively (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: A negative attitude, he warned, would negatively affect the team and negate every effort at teamwork. （neg- = 否定，-ion 构名词，-ive 构形容词，-ly 构副词）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·may be negated by (被动 + by 施动)
advancedExpressions.expression: sth may be negated by ...
advancedExpressions.example: The value of power may be negated by what one does with it. （被动语态 be negated + by 引出"抵消它的东西"，课文核心句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a single moment, ... seemed to negate everything ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a single reckless moment, his harsh words seemed to negate everything they had once meant to each other — yet, deep down, he knew love did not vanish so easily. （破折号转折+yet 反转，续写情感层次）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us not allow ... to negate the efforts of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us not allow a moment's carelessness to negate the efforts of all those who have worked so hard to make our school a greener place. （Let us not 委婉呼吁+of 后置强调集体努力）

advancedExpressions.expression: this by no means negates the fact that ...
advancedExpressions.example: While technology has its drawbacks, this by no means negates the fact that it has transformed education for the better. （While 让步+by no means 双重否定加强，凸显核心论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: His bad behaviour cancelled out his good work.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In one thoughtless instant, a fit of temper negated months of patient kindness, and the goodwill he had so carefully nurtured crumbled like a sandcastle before the rising tide. （读后续写·冲动的代价）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In one thoughtless instant 时间状语铺垫 + negated 精准动词 + crumbled like a sandcastle before the rising tide 明喻意象收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: One mistake should not ruin all your hard work.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We must never let a solitary misstep negate the fruits of our sustained and disciplined labour, for perseverance is measured not by flawless streaks but by the courage to rise again. （议论文·坚持的意义）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: never let... negate 强调句式 + solitary/sustained 词汇升级 + for 引导原因分句 + not...but 对比结构升华

classPractice.question: Such power has obvious value—even though the power may ____ ____ ____ (被抵消) by what one does with it.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点：power 与 negate 为被动关系，情态动词 may + be + 过去分词 negated，by 引出施动者。

classPractice.question: 一次失败并不能否定你所取得的一切的价值。(用 negate the value of)
classPractice.answer: A single failure does not negate the value of everything you have achieved.
classPractice.note: negate the value of = 否定……的价值；negate 及物动词，宾语为抽象名词短语。

classPractice.question: A ____ (negate) attitude towards new ideas can quietly ____ (negate) years of progress.
classPractice.note: 词族转换：修饰 attitude 用形容词 negative；情态/助动词后仍用动词原形 negate。

translation: adj. 脑力的；有才智的，智力发达的 | n. 知识分子，脑力劳动者
original_sentence: Another value of science is the intellectual enjoyment it can provide us with.
readingExamples: Another value of science is the intellectual enjoyment it can provide us with.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to the ability to think in an advanced way, to reason and understand ideas
(2) adj. (of a person) intelligent and interested in serious study and thought
(3) n. a person who is well educated and enjoys thinking deeply about complex ideas, theories and knowledge

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】知识分子（intellectual 作名词，常用复数 intellectuals）
uncommonMeanings.example: The reforms were welcomed by many intellectuals of the day. 这些改革受到当时许多知识分子的欢迎。

posExamples.sentence: As she turned the final page, an intellectual thrill she had never felt before surged through her, and for the first time she understood why her old teacher called books 'windows to boundless worlds'. （读后续写·阅读的觉醒）
We are honoured to invite Professor Lin, a renowned intellectual whose research has reshaped our understanding of ancient poetry, to deliver the opening lecture of our reading festival. （应用文·邀请函）
True education should nourish not only intellectual growth but also moral character, for a brilliant mind untethered from conscience can do great harm. （议论文·全面发展）
The chess club offers students a rare kind of intellectual challenge, sharpening their patience and foresight in ways no textbook ever could. （应用文·社团介绍）

wordForms.noun: intellect (智力，才智); intellectual (知识分子); intellectualism (智力至上主义)
wordForms.adjective: intellectual (智力的); intelligent (聪明的); intelligible (可理解的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：intellect + -ual → intellectual（名词加 -ual 变形容词/名词）。辨析熟词：intellect n. 智力/才智（the human intellect），是抽象名词；intellectual 既作形容词也作名词（知识分子）。词根 -lect-（源自 legere，选择/理解）亦见于 intelligent、select、collect

collocations.example: Another value of science is the intellectual enjoyment it can provide us with. 科学的另一价值是它能给我们带来智力的享受。（课件原句）
His intellectual curiosity drove him to take apart every broken clock he could find. 求知欲驱使他拆开能找到的每一只坏钟。

collocations.translation: 【课件】考验智力的（intellectually 为副词，修饰 challenging）
collocations.example: The puzzle was intellectually challenging, keeping the whole class absorbed for an hour. 这道题很考验智力，让全班专注了一个小时。
As a leading intellectual of her time, she used her pen to awaken a generation. 作为她那个时代一位杰出的知识分子，她用笔唤醒了一代人。

collocations.translation: 智力上的乐趣，思考的乐趣（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Another value of science is the intellectual enjoyment it can provide us with. （课文原句）
His intellectual curiosity drove him to take apart every broken clock he could find. （少年探索）
Respecting others' intellectual property is a mark of genuine integrity. （诚信）
A stimulating home lays a firm foundation for a child's intellectual development. （家庭教育）
The debate posed an intellectual challenge that pushed everyone to think harder. （活动感悟）
Regular reading gradually strengthens our intellectual ability. （阅读益处）
As a leading intellectual of her time, she used her pen to awaken a generation. （人物传记）
Scientific research is far from a lonely intellectual pursuit. （科学精神）
Solving that final riddle brought her an intellectual pleasure far sweeter than any prize could offer. （读后续写·思考之乐）

synonyms.example: The intelligent child grasped the puzzle in seconds. （聪慧儿童）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：intelligent 指天生聪明、反应快、领悟力强，形容人；intellectual 强调理性思考、学术兴趣、深度思维，可修饰人也可修饰活动（如 intellectual enjoyment）。句法上二者都作定语/表语，但 intellectual 常搭抽象名词，intelligent 多直接修饰人或行为

synonyms.example: His scholarly essay, dense with careful reasoning, won wide admiration. （学术）
synonyms.usage: 侧重与学术研究相关、严谨博学；intellectual 范围更广，既可指人也可指抽象的思维活动

synonyms.example: His films were coldly cerebral, appealing to the mind far more than to the heart. （人物风格）
synonyms.usage: 较文学化，强调偏重理性、缺乏情感温度；intellectual 为中性褒义，日常与书面均可用

advancedExpressions.expression: intellectual enjoyment / curiosity / property / pursuit / challenge
advancedExpressions.example: 从课文 intellectual enjoyment 出发，成串记：intellectual curiosity（求知欲）、intellectual property（知识产权）、intellectual pursuit（学术追求），写议论文谈科学与教育时可信手拈来。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「聪明/有才智的」（可替换形容词）
advancedExpressions.expression: intelligent / brilliant / bright / gifted / sharp-minded
advancedExpressions.example: 表达'聪明的学生'：an intelligent / brilliant / bright / gifted student 均可互换；若强调'重理性思考的'则用 intellectual。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ual 形容词后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: intellect → intellectual; habit → habitual; concept → conceptual
advancedExpressions.example: 名词加 -ual 常构成形容词：intellect→intellectual, habit→habitual, concept→conceptual, event→eventual。

advancedExpressions.expression: an intellectual awakening stirred within sb.
advancedExpressions.example: As the professor spoke, an intellectual awakening stirred within him, and the dull world suddenly brimmed with questions worth chasing. （抽象名词作主语+within sb.）

advancedExpressions.expression: an event that offers both intellectual stimulation and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our science fair offers both intellectual stimulation and hands-on fun. （both...and 并列凸显双重价值）

advancedExpressions.expression: genuine education fosters intellectual as well as ... growth
advancedExpressions.example: Genuine education fosters intellectual as well as emotional growth. （as well as 平衡结构，凸显全面发展）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Reading made her smarter and happier.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With every book she devoured, an intellectual world unfolded before her — vast, luminous, endlessly inviting — and a quiet joy took root in a heart that had once known only loneliness. （读后续写·阅读改变人生）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With every... 状语铺陈 + 破折号插入三个形容词递进(vast, luminous, endlessly inviting) + took root in a heart 拟物化收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: Education is not only about knowledge but also character.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Education, in its truest sense, ought to nurture not merely intellectual brilliance but also moral integrity, shaping individuals who think with clarity and act with conscience. （议论文·育人本质）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in its truest sense 插入语提升格调 + not merely...but also 递进强调 + think with clarity/act with conscience 平行对偶收束

classPractice.question: Another value of science is the ____ (intellect) enjoyment it can provide us with.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；名词 intellect 加 -ual 变形容词 intellectual 修饰 enjoyment

classPractice.question: The child is so ____ (intelligent / intellectual) that she solved the riddle in seconds.
classPractice.note: 形容天生聪明、反应快用 intelligent；intellectual 强调理性/学术思维

classPractice.question: 作为她那个时代一位杰出的知识分子，她用笔唤醒了一代人。As a leading ____, she used her pen to awaken a generation.
classPractice.note: 此处 intellectual 作名词'知识分子'，可数，前加冠词 a leading

translation: 神秘；神秘的人（或事物）；悬疑作品
original_sentence: When we look at any question deeply enough, we feel the excitement and mystery coming to us again and again.
readingExamples: When we look at any question deeply enough, we feel the excitement and mystery coming to us again and again.
definitionEn:
(1) n. something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain
(2) n. the quality of being secret, strange or difficult to explain
(3) n. a person or thing about which little is known
(4) n. a story, film or play dealing with a puzzling crime, especially a murder

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （宗教）奥迹，神秘仪式（常用复数 mysteries，指秘传的宗教仪式或真理）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the flickering candlelight of the ancient temple, the old priest revealed the sacred mysteries only to those deemed worthy, and the boy felt a shiver run down his spine. （读后续写·古老仪式·神秘氛围）

posExamples.sentence: As the fog curled around the abandoned lighthouse, an air of mystery wrapped the whole island, and the children dared not take another step forward. （读后续写·探险悬疑）
This weekend our book club will discuss a classic mystery novel, so please read the first ten chapters in advance and come ready to share your suspicions. （应用文·通知）
The universe remains an endless mystery, and it is precisely this unknown that fuels humanity's ceaseless quest for knowledge. （议论文·科学探索）
How the ancient builders raised such enormous stones without modern machines is still a mystery that baffles historians to this day. （议论文·历史谜题）

idioms.translation: 笼罩在神秘之中，扑朔迷离
idioms.example: The old mansion at the end of the lane had long been shrouded in mystery, its shuttered windows guarding secrets no living soul could name. （读后续写·神秘老宅）
Her sudden disappearance remained wrapped in mystery, and the whole town whispered about it for years afterward. （读后续写·失踪悬案）

collocations.translation: 兴奋与神秘（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: When we look at any question deeply enough, we feel the excitement and mystery coming to us again and again. （课文原句）
Determined to unravel the mystery of the missing manuscript, she pored over dusty records. （探案）
How she stayed so calm under such pressure was a complete mystery to her classmates. （人物）
The masked stranger carried an air of mystery that drew every curious gaze. （人物登场）
Why the ancient civilization vanished so abruptly remains a mystery. （未解之谜）
The inventor deliberately cloaked his new device in mystery. （发明家）

collocations.phrase: the mystery of life / the universe
collocations.example: Standing beneath the star-strewn sky, he longed to probe the mystery of the universe. （仰望星空）
The newly discovered letters finally shed light on a mystery that had haunted the family. （真相大白）
The strange footprints in the snow only deepened the mystery around the cabin. （悬疑推进）

synonyms.example: The disappearance of the keys was a puzzle that kept the family searching till midnight. （日常谜题）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：puzzle 偏具体、可求解的难题或谜语，语气较轻；mystery 更带神秘、不可知的色彩，常渲染氛围（an air of mystery）。句法上均可数，puzzle 常搭 solve，mystery 常搭 solve/unravel/remain

synonyms.translation: 费解的事物，谜一般的人
synonyms.example: Even after years of friendship, she remained an enigma to him. （人物刻画）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、文学化，多形容令人捉摸不透的人或事；mystery 应用更广，日常书面均可

synonyms.example: He guarded the secret of his family's past so fiercely. （隐情）
synonyms.usage: 指有意隐瞒、可被知晓的信息；mystery 指本身难以解释、未必有人故意隐藏

advancedExpressions.expression: an air of mystery / solve a mystery / remain a mystery / a mystery to sb
advancedExpressions.example: 记叙营造神秘：an air of mystery（神秘气氛）；推动情节：solve/unravel a mystery（解谜）；留白：remain a mystery（仍是谜）；主观感受：be a mystery to sb（对某人是谜）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「谜/难以解释之事」（可替换名词）
advancedExpressions.expression: mystery / puzzle / enigma / riddle
advancedExpressions.example: 表达'一个未解之谜'：an unsolved mystery / puzzle / riddle 均可；形容'谜一般的人'多用 an enigma。

advancedExpressions.expression: mystery (n.) → mysterious (adj.) → mysteriously (adv.); mystify (v.) → mystifying (adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: 名词 mystery 去 y 加 -ious 变形容词 mysterious（神秘的），再加 -ly 变副词 mysteriously；动词 mystify（使困惑）。

advancedExpressions.expression: an air of mystery hung over ...
advancedExpressions.example: An air of mystery hung over the silent valley, where even the wind seemed to hold its breath. （抽象名词+hang over 营造悬疑）

advancedExpressions.expression: unravel the mystery of ... together
advancedExpressions.example: Come and join our Science Week, where we will unravel the mystery of light, sound and motion together! （祈使句+together 拉近距离）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is the mystery of the unknown that drives ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is the very mystery of the unknown that drives humankind ever forward. （强调句 it is...that+抽象升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old house looked strange and frightening.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Cloaked in mystery and half-swallowed by creeping ivy, the old house loomed at the end of the lane, its darkened windows staring back like the hollow eyes of something long forgotten. （读后续写·恐怖悬疑）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Cloaked in mystery 过去分词开头 + half-swallowed by creeping ivy 拟物 + loomed 强动词 + like the hollow eyes 明喻收尾营造惊悚

sentenceUpgrade.original: There are still many things about the universe we do not understand.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The universe still guards countless mysteries beyond our grasp, and it is this boundless unknown that keeps the flame of human curiosity forever burning. （议论文·科学探索）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: guards countless mysteries 拟人化 + beyond our grasp 意象 + it is...that 强调句 + keeps the flame...burning 隐喻升华

classPractice.question: The disappearance of the ancient city has ____ (mystery) historians for centuries and remains unexplained.
classPractice.note: 此处需动词 mystify（使困惑），过去分词/过去式作谓语；mystery 的动词形式为 mystify

classPractice.question: The masked stranger carried an ____ of mystery that drew every curious gaze in the room.
classPractice.note: an air of mystery 一种神秘气氛，读后续写人物登场常用

classPractice.question: 她如何在如此压力下保持镇定，对同学们来说是个谜。How she stayed so calm under such pressure was ____ ____ ____ to her classmates.
classPractice.answer: a complete mystery / a total mystery
classPractice.note: be a mystery to sb 对某人来说是个谜；可加 complete/total 强调

original_sentence: Never concerned that the answer may let us down, with pleasure and confidence we turn over each new stone to find unimagined strangeness leading on to more wonderful questions and mysteries.
readingExamples: Never concerned that the answer may let us down, with pleasure and confidence we turn over each new stone to find unimagined strangeness leading on to more wonderful questions and mysteries.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to fail to help or support someone, especially when they were depending on you; to disappoint someone
(2) phr. v. to make someone feel disappointed because something is not as good as they had hoped
(3) phr. v. (literal) to lower someone or something to a lower position

posExamples.sentence: As he crossed the finish line last, he could not meet his father's eyes, terrified that once again he had let the old man down. （读后续写·父子·愧疚）
I promise I will practise every single day and never let the team down when the final match arrives. （应用文·承诺/回信）
A true leader never lets his followers down in times of crisis, for it is precisely in the darkest hours that trust is either forged or forever broken. （议论文·责任与信任）
We should never let down those who believe in us; instead, their faith ought to spur us on to reach ever higher. （议论文·不负期望）

wordForms.noun: a letdown / let-down (n. 令人失望的人或事)
wordForms.verb: let sb down (使某人失望); disappoint (使失望)
wordForms.other: 词性转换：动词短语 let sb down → 名词 a letdown（连写，一件令人失望的事：The film was a real letdown.）。近义动词 disappoint 可直接接宾语（disappoint sb），而 let 与 down 之间必须插入宾语（let sb down，代词只能放中间，不能说 let down her）

idioms.example: After weeks of relentless exams, the students finally let their hair down at the summer camp, singing around the crackling bonfire until midnight. （读后续写·放松狂欢）
He worked twice as hard in training, determined never to let the side down in front of the fans who had cheered for him all season. （读后续写·集体荣誉）

collocations.phrase: the answer may let us down
collocations.translation: 【课件】答案可能会令我们失望（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Never concerned that the answer may let us down, with pleasure and confidence we turn over each new stone. 我们从不担心答案可能会令人失望，总是快乐而自信地开始每一次新探索。（课件原句）
The whole team count on Messi, and he seldom lets them down. 整个队都指望着梅西，他很少让他们失望。（课件语境应用）

collocations.translation: 【课件】更不用说（用于否定句后，引出更不可能的情况）
collocations.example: Many young graduates struggle to find any job, let alone a good one. 许多年轻毕业生很难找到工作，更不用说找到一份好工作了。（课件语境应用）

collocations.translation: 【课件】泄露（消息）；发出（声音）；放出
collocations.example: Don't let out the news of me losing my job, will you? 别把我丢了工作一事泄露出去，行吗？（课件语境应用）
He finally let go of the rope and slid safely down. 他终于松开绳子，安全地滑了下来。
She opened the door to let the cold, wet cat in. 她开门让又冷又湿的猫进来。

collocations.phrase: the answer may let us down
collocations.translation: 答案可能让我们失望（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Never concerned that the answer may let us down, with pleasure and confidence we turn over each new stone. （课文原句）
When he broke his solemn promise, he let his little sister down badly. （失信）
Grandma had believed in me through every stumble, and I vowed never to let her down. （誓言）
The audience felt badly let down when the concert was cancelled at the last minute. （投诉/反馈）
By giving up so easily, she felt she had let herself down more than anyone else could. （自省）
Only when he let down his guard did the frightened stray dog creep forward. （信任建立）

collocations.phrase: not want to let sb down
collocations.example: She stayed up all night rehearsing, for she did not want to let down her teacher. （不负期待）

synonyms.example: He was afraid his poor grades would disappoint his parents. （愧疚）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：disappoint 为正式书面动词，单纯表'使失望'，可直接接宾语（disappoint sb）；let sb down 更口语，隐含'辜负了信任或期望'的责任感，且 down 与宾语位置固定（let me down，不可 let down me）

synonyms.translation: 辜负某人，未能帮到某人
synonyms.example: The old doctor felt he had failed his patient. （医者自责）
synonyms.usage: 语气更沉重，强调在关键时刻没能尽到责任；let sb down 语气稍轻，日常口语常用

synonyms.example: To reveal the secret would be to betray the trust his best friend had placed in him. （忠诚考验）
synonyms.usage: 程度最重，含'背叛'之意，多用于严重失信；let sb down 多指未达期望，未必是主动背叛

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·find+宾补（done/doing/adj/n/介短；find it adj to do）
advancedExpressions.expression: find sb/sth done（被……）/ find sb/sth doing（正在……）/ find sb/sth + adj./adv./n./介短（觉得……）/ find sb/sth adj. to do / find it adj. to do
advancedExpressions.example: 课件讲点：I found the job boring.（adj.）/ We found him working in the garden.（doing）/ he found the door closed（done）/ I found him the man who saved me.（n.）/ When I came to, I found myself in my mother's arms.（介短）/ The boy found the novel difficult to read.（adj.+to do）/ I found it hard to get along with his brother.（find it adj. to do）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·let 高频短语（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: let sb down（让某人失望）/ let alone（更不用说）/ let out（泄露/放出）/ let go (of)（松手/放下）/ let sb in（让某人进来）
advancedExpressions.example: 课件集中辨析：he seldom lets them down / any job, let alone a good one / don't let out the news / let go of the rope / let the cat in。

advancedExpressions.expression: let sb down（使失望）/ let down one's guard（放松警惕）/ let oneself down（辜负自己）
advancedExpressions.example: 同一 let...down 结构，宾语不同含义不同：let sb down 使人失望、let one's guard down 放松警惕、let one's hair down 尽情放松。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「使某人失望/辜负」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: let sb down / disappoint sb / fail sb / not live up to sb's expectations
advancedExpressions.example: 表达'不想让父母失望'：I don't want to let my parents down / disappoint them / fail them / fall short of their expectations.

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·动词短语转名词
advancedExpressions.expression: let sb down → a letdown (n.)
advancedExpressions.example: 口语中把 let...down 连写成名词 a letdown（令人失望之事）：After all the hype, the ending was a huge letdown.

advancedExpressions.expression: the thought of letting sb down was more than sb. could bear
advancedExpressions.example: The thought of letting his ailing mother down was more than he could bear. （抽象主语+more than sb. could bear）

advancedExpressions.expression: rest assured that I will never let you down
advancedExpressions.example: Rest assured that, once entrusted with this responsibility, I will never let you down. （祈使句 Rest assured 开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who honour their word never let others down
advancedExpressions.example: Those who honour their word and never let others down become the very pillars upon which trust is rebuilt. （定语从句+隐喻 pillars）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was sad because he had disappointed his father.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A wave of shame washed over him as he realized he had let his father down yet again; unable to bear the quiet sorrow in the old man's eyes, he turned away, his throat tight with unspoken apology. （读后续写·父子愧疚）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: A wave of shame washed over him 心理描写具象化 + let down 短语 + unable to bear... 分词状语 + throat tight with unspoken apology 生理细节收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not disappoint people who trust us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We ought never to let down those who have placed their faith in us; rather, their unwavering trust should stir within us the resolve to prove ourselves worthy of it. （议论文·不负信任）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: ought never to 强化道德义务 + let down 短语 + rather 转折 + stir within us the resolve 抽象名词升华 + worthy of it 呼应主题

classPractice.question: The whole team count on Messi, and he seldom ____________. 整个队都指望着梅西，他很少让他们失望。
classPractice.note: 课件语境应用；let sb down 让某人失望，宾语 them 置于 let 与 down 之间；主语 he 用第三人称单数 lets

classPractice.question: Many young graduates struggle to find any job ________ a good one. 许多年轻毕业生很难找到工作，更不用说找一份好工作了。
classPractice.note: 课件语境应用；let alone 更不用说，用于否定或含否定意味的句子后，引出更不可能的情况

classPractice.question: Don't __________ the news of me losing my job, will you? 别把我丢了工作一事泄露出去，行吗？
classPractice.note: 课件语境应用；let out 泄露（消息）；注意反意疑问 will you

classPractice.question: 他们在森林中发现他受伤了。
classPractice.answer: They found him injured in the forest.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；find sb done 发现某人被……，injured 为过去分词作宾补，he 与 injure 是被动关系

classPractice.question: 当我们到达时，发现他在睡觉。
classPractice.answer: When we arrived, we found him in bed.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；find sb + 介词短语（in bed 在睡觉）作宾补；亦可 found him sleeping（现在分词作宾补）

classPractice.question: 我发现这项工作令人厌烦。
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；find sth + adj.（boring）作宾补，觉得某物……

classPractice.question: 当他回到家的时候，他发现门是关着的。
classPractice.answer: When he came home, he found the door closed.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；find sth done，the door 与 close 是被动关系，用过去分词 closed 作宾补

classPractice.type: 翻译·课件（find it adj to do）
classPractice.question: 我发现很难同他的兄弟相处。
classPractice.answer: I found it hard to get along with his brother.
classPractice.note: 课件翻译原题；find it adj. to do，it 为形式宾语，真宾语为 to get along with...

classPractice.question: 决不担心答案可能会让我们失望。Never concerned that the answer may ____ us ____, we turn over each new stone.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；let sb down 使某人失望，代词 us 置于 let 和 down 之间

classPractice.question: I don't want to disappoint the teacher who trusts me. → I don't want to ____ the teacher ____ .
classPractice.note: let sb down = disappoint sb；注意 down 位置固定在宾语之后

classPractice.question: After all the excitement, the boring ending was a real ____ (letdown / disappoint).
classPractice.note: 此处需名词，用 a letdown（令人失望之事）；disappoint 是动词不能作名词

original_sentence: The scientist has a lot of experience with ignorance and doubt and uncertainty, and this experience is of very great importance.
readingExamples: The scientist has a lot of experience with ignorance and doubt and uncertainty, and this experience is of very great importance.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a lack of knowledge, information, or education about something
(2) n. the state of not knowing about a particular thing or being unaware of it
(3) n. (formal) the condition of being uneducated or unenlightened

posExamples.sentence: Only when she stepped into the vast library did she grasp the depth of her own ignorance, and a hunger to learn stirred within her heart like a rising flame. （读后续写·求知觉醒）
Through this science lecture series, we hope to dispel the ignorance that still surrounds many common illnesses and to help every student make wiser choices. （应用文·活动倡议）
Ignorance, far more than knowledge, is the true breeding ground of prejudice; only education can light the way out of its shadow. （议论文·教育与偏见）
Many conflicts spring not from malice but from sheer ignorance of one another's cultures and beliefs. （议论文·跨文化理解）

wordForms.other: ignoramus (无知的人, 贬)。辨析熟词：ignorance n. 无知（不知道）vs ignore v. 忽视（知道却故意不理会），二者形近义不同，是高考高频易混点。ignorant of sth 对某事无知（be ignorant of the rules）

idioms.translation: 无知是福（不知反而快乐）
idioms.example: Perhaps ignorance is bliss, she thought, for the more she learned about the world's troubles, the heavier her once-carefree heart became. （成长感悟）

collocations.translation: 【课件】n. 无知（lack of knowledge or information about sth）
collocations.example: It is said that poverty and ignorance are the enemies of progress. 有人说，贫穷和无知是进步之敌。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……不了解／一无所知（ignorant adj. 不了解的，无知的）
collocations.example: We remain ignorant of the causes of this disease. 我们对这个疾病的起因仍然一无所知。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 与无知和怀疑打交道的经历（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The scientist has a lot of experience with ignorance and doubt and uncertainty. （课文原句）
The hurtful remark had been made out of ignorance rather than malice. （谅解）
His complete ignorance of the local customs led to one awkward misunderstanding after another. （文化冲突）
A single inspiring teacher can dispel the ignorance of an entire generation. （教育力量）
For years his family had kept him in ignorance of the truth. （隐瞒真相）
It was sheer ignorance, not cruelty, that made the villagers fear the stranger. （误解）
She had gone on smiling, blissfully in ignorance of the storm gathering at home. （反差铺垫）
Fear is often born of ignorance; understanding makes half our dread disappear. （恐惧与认知）
Education remains our most powerful weapon in the fight against ignorance. （教育使命）

synonyms.example: Her complete unawareness of the danger made her cheerful humming all the more heart-wrenching. （反讽铺垫）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：unawareness 指对某一具体事物没有察觉，中性；ignorance 范围更广，可指整体缺乏知识或教育，含贬义。注意与动词 ignore（忽视，故意不理会）区分——ignorance 是'不知道'，ignore 是'知道却不理会'

synonyms.example: In that remote village, illiteracy had trapped generations in poverty. （支教）
synonyms.usage: 特指不会读写这一具体状态；ignorance 泛指缺乏知识，不限于读写能力

synonyms.example: There was a touching innocence in the child's questions. （童真）
synonyms.usage: 含褒义或中性，强调纯真无邪；ignorance 多为中性偏贬，强调知识的缺失

advancedExpressions.expression: out of ignorance（出于无知）/ in ignorance of（不知……）/ keep sb in ignorance（使蒙在鼓里）/ dispel ignorance（驱散无知）
advancedExpressions.example: 谅解他人：done out of ignorance；铺垫反差：in ignorance of…；教育力量：dispel/drive out/fight ignorance。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「无知/缺乏了解」（可替换名词）
advancedExpressions.expression: ignorance / lack of knowledge / unawareness
advancedExpressions.example: 表达'出于无知'：out of ignorance / out of a lack of knowledge / out of unawareness.

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·ignor- 词族与辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: ignore (v.) → ignorance (n.) → ignorant (adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: 同根词 ignore/ignorance/ignorant，但 ignore=忽视（知道却不理），ignorance=无知（不知道），写作切勿混用。

advancedExpressions.expression: Ignorance is bliss.
advancedExpressions.example: 谚语'无知是福'，抽象名词作主语时不加冠词：Ignorance is bliss；同类 Knowledge is power.

advancedExpressions.expression: it was her own ignorance, she realized, that had ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was her own ignorance, she realized with a pang, that had blinded her to her friend's quiet suffering. （强调句+with a pang 心理细节）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us drive out ignorance through ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us drive out ignorance through reading, for every book is a window onto a broader world. （祈使句呼吁+隐喻 window）

advancedExpressions.expression: knowledge is the surest antidote to ignorance
advancedExpressions.example: Knowledge is the surest antidote to ignorance. （比喻 antidote，凸显教育价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She did not know much, and this made her want to learn.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Confronted with the boundless ocean of human knowledge, she suddenly felt the sting of her own ignorance — and in that very moment, a quiet but fierce determination to learn took root deep within her. （读后续写·求知觉醒）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Confronted with... 分词状语开头 + boundless ocean of knowledge 隐喻 + felt the sting of ignorance 通感 + took root deep within her 拟物化收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: Education can help people overcome ignorance.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Education, in the end, is the one lamp capable of driving back the darkness of ignorance, guiding humanity, step by hesitant step, toward the light of reason and understanding. （议论文·教育力量）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in the end 插入语 + the one lamp...darkness of ignorance 光明/黑暗隐喻 + step by hesitant step 副词短语增添画面 + toward the light of reason 意象呼应升华

classPractice.question: We remain ____ (ignorance) of the causes of this disease. 我们对这个疾病的起因仍然一无所知。
classPractice.note: 课件原句；remain 后接形容词作表语，名词 ignorance → 形容词 ignorant；be/remain ignorant of 对……一无所知

classPractice.question: She spoke rudely not out of malice but out of pure ____ (ignorance / ignore); she simply did not know the custom.
classPractice.note: 辨析核心：out of ignorance 出于无知（名词）；ignore 是动词'忽视'，此处需名词

classPractice.question: The scientist has a lot of experience with ignorance and doubt, and he is never ____ (ignorance) of how much he still needs to learn.
classPractice.note: 改编自课文语境；be ignorant of 对……无知，此处需形容词 ignorant

classPractice.question: 或许无知是福。Perhaps ____ ____ ____ , she thought, for the more she learned, the heavier her heart became.
classPractice.note: 谚语 ignorance is bliss（无知是福）；抽象名词作主语不加冠词

original_sentence: When he has an idea as to what the result is, he is uncertain.
readingExamples: When he has an idea as to what the result is, he is uncertain.
definitionEn:
(1) prep. about or concerning a particular thing, especially when introducing a question or matter of uncertainty
(2) prep. used to introduce the subject that a decision, choice or judgement relates to
(3) prep. according to; in terms of (used when grading or classifying things)

posExamples.sentence: As she stared at the yellowed letter trembling in her hands, a hundred questions raced through her mind as to who had written it and why it had lain hidden for so many years. （读后续写·悬念铺垫）
I am writing to seek your advice as to whether an overseas exchange programme would truly benefit a student like me who tends to feel homesick easily. （应用文·咨询信）
Opinions differ widely as to whether social media has strengthened or weakened genuine human connection, yet few would deny its profound impact on the way we communicate. （议论文·科技利弊）
Before the expedition set out, the guide gave us clear instructions as to how we should conserve our water in the desert. （读后续写·冒险准备）

idioms.translation: 关于，至于（引出话题或待定的具体问题）
idioms.example: As to how the accident happened, no one could give a clear answer. （引出话题）

collocations.translation: 关于……的想法/头绪（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: When he has an idea as to what the result is, he is uncertain. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: have no idea as to sth
collocations.example: Standing in the fog, we had no idea as to which path would lead us back. （迷路情节）

collocations.phrase: a question / doubt as to whether ...
collocations.example: A nagging doubt as to whether she had made the right decision kept her awake. （心理挣扎）
Could you offer me some advice as to how I might improve my spoken English? （请求信）
The committee has yet to make a final decision as to where the sports meeting will be held. （通知）
There remains uncertainty as to the long-term effects of prolonged screen time. （健康）
Opinions differ as to whether handwriting should still be taught in a digital age. （教育）
The coach gave precise instructions as to when each swimmer should dive in. （比赛）
There was confusion among the freshmen as to which building the ceremony was in. （校园通知）

synonyms.example: Regarding your enquiry about the summer camp, I am delighted to provide the details. （回信）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：regarding 更正式，常见于书信开头引出整个话题；as to 多用于引出疑问或不确定的具体点，常接 whether/how/what 等间接疑问，句法上可置于名词后（a doubt as to whether...）或句首

synonyms.example: Concerning the environmental impact of the factory, residents have voiced concerns. （环保）
synonyms.usage: 书面、庄重，指'与……有关'；as to 更侧重'至于某个待定的具体问题'

synonyms.example: She was still unsure about what to say when the teacher called her name. （日常）
synonyms.usage: 最口语、最通用；as to 在引出 whether/how/what 等间接疑问时显得更书面、更精准

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·as to 引导间接疑问
advancedExpressions.expression: a doubt / question / idea / decision + as to whether / how / what ...
advancedExpressions.example: as to 后常接名词从句：a doubt as to whether…（是否的疑问）、advice as to how…（如何的建议）、a decision as to where…（何处的决定）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「关于/至于」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: as to / regarding / concerning / with regard to / as for
advancedExpressions.example: 书面引出话题：As to / Regarding / Concerning / With regard to the plan, we need more time.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·as to 后接名词性从句
advancedExpressions.expression: as to + wh-/whether 从句
advancedExpressions.example: as to 是介词短语，后须接名词或名词性从句，从句用陈述语序：as to what the result is（不是 what is the result）。

advancedExpressions.expression: a flood of questions arose as to ...
advancedExpressions.example: A flood of questions arose in my mind as to what had really happened that stormy night. （破折号补充+间接疑问）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would be grateful for your guidance as to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would be grateful for your guidance as to how best to prepare for the competition. （客套句式+as to 引出请求焦点）

advancedExpressions.expression: opinions remain sharply divided as to whether ...
advancedExpressions.example: Opinions remain sharply divided as to whether AI will liberate or replace the human workforce. （引出争议话题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I didn't know what to do.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For a long moment I stood frozen, utterly at a loss as to what I should do next, my heart pounding like a drum against my ribs. （读后续写·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: at a loss as to 固定短语替换 didn't know + 状语前置(For a long moment) + 明喻(like a drum) 增强画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: People disagree about whether homework is useful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As education reform gathers pace, opinions differ markedly as to whether copious amounts of homework genuinely enhance learning or merely burden already exhausted students. （议论文·教育）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as to whether 引出争议 + 副词 markedly 强调分歧 + 平行结构(enhance...or merely burden) 呈现两面

classPractice.question: When he has an idea ____ ____ what the result is, he is still uncertain and keeps testing.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；as to = 关于，后接间接疑问 what the result is（陈述语序）

classPractice.question: 对于这场事故是如何发生的，人们看法不一。Opinions differ ____ ____ how the accident happened.
classPractice.note: opinions differ as to… 对……看法不一；as to 后接 how 引导的名词从句

classPractice.question: I would be grateful for your advice ____ (as to / for) how I might improve my writing before the exam.
classPractice.note: advice as to how… 关于如何……的建议；as for 多用于句首转换话题，不搭 advice

translation: 想当然地认为，认为…是理所当然
original_sentence: Now, we scientists take it for granted that it is perfectly possible to live and not know.
readingExamples: Now, we scientists take it for granted that it is perfectly possible to live and not know.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to assume that something is true or certain to happen without questioning or checking it
(2) phr. to fail to appreciate the value of someone or something because they are always there or easily available
(3) phr. take it for granted that ... : to accept something as an obvious fact requiring no proof

posExamples.sentence: For years I had taken my grandmother's presence for granted, but the moment the doctor lowered his voice in the corridor, I realized how fragile that quiet love had always been. （读后续写·亲情感悟）
I am writing to remind fellow students that we should never take the tireless work of our cleaners for granted; a simple word of thanks can brighten their entire day. （应用文·倡议书）
Too often we take our freedom of speech for granted, forgetting that it was won through the sacrifice of countless people who came before us. （议论文·社会/历史）
The young explorer had always taken it for granted that the mountain path would be there, until a landslide swept it away overnight. （读后续写·冒险）

idioms.example: We took it for granted that the shop would still be open at nine, only to find its shutters firmly down. （读后续写·意外转折）

collocations.translation: 【课件】想当然地认为……（to believe that sth is true without making sure；it 为形式宾语）
collocations.example: Now, we scientists take it for granted that it is perfectly possible to live and not know. 现在，我们科学家理所当然地认为，人类生而有所不知是完全有可能的。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】认为某人/某物理所当然（而不珍惜）
collocations.example: Her parents were always there and she just took them for granted. 她的父母随时都出现在她身边，她却认为他们理应如此。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 想当然地认为……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Now, we scientists take it for granted that it is perfectly possible to live and not know. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 不珍惜某人/某物，视之为理所当然
collocations.example: It was only after moving abroad that she stopped taking her mother's meals for granted. （思乡）

collocations.phrase: should not be taken for granted
collocations.example: The clean air of our hometown should never be taken for granted. （倡议书）
We tend to take for granted the conveniences that modern technology quietly provides. （科技）

collocations.phrase: no longer take sth for granted
collocations.translation: 不再把某事视为理所当然
collocations.example: After the flood, the family no longer took a warm, dry bed for granted. （灾难后成长）
He vowed to stop taking his loyal friends for granted. （友情）

collocations.phrase: be wrong to take sth for granted
collocations.translation: 把某事视为当然是错误的
collocations.example: We would be wrong to take the peace of our times for granted. （历史）

synonyms.example: She assumed the door would be unlocked, and pushed it open without a second thought. （日常）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：assume 中性，指'不加证明地认定'，后接 that 从句；take it for granted 语气更强，且常带'本不该如此想当然'的批评意味。注意结构：take it for granted that…（用形式宾语 it，真宾语为 that 从句），或 take sb/sth for granted

synonyms.example: I presume you have already received my previous email. （礼貌推断）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，基于一定理由的推断；take it for granted 更口语、更强调'未经思考'

synonyms.example: We often underestimate the impact a single act of kindness can have. （人性）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'低估价值'；当 take sth for granted 表'不珍惜'时二者相近，但后者强调'习以为常而忽视'

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·take ... for granted 两大用法
advancedExpressions.expression: take it for granted that + 从句（想当然认为）/ take sb/sth for granted（不珍惜）
advancedExpressions.example: 接从句用形式宾语：take it for granted that…；接人或物：take her love / good health for granted（不珍惜）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「想当然认为」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: take it for granted that / assume that / presume that / take it as given that
advancedExpressions.example: 表达'人们想当然地认为成功一夜而来'：People take it for granted that / assume that / presume that success comes overnight.

advancedExpressions.expression: take it for granted that ...（it 为形式宾语，that 从句为真宾语）
advancedExpressions.example: 当宾语是从句时，需用 it 占位：take it for granted that…；不能说 take that…for granted。

advancedExpressions.expression: only when ... did sb stop taking ... for granted
advancedExpressions.example: Only when the lights went out across the city did we stop taking electricity for granted. （倒装+对比）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us never take ... for granted
advancedExpressions.example: Let us never take the dedication of our teachers for granted. （祈使呼吁+对比收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is dangerous / short-sighted to take ... for granted
advancedExpressions.example: It is short-sighted to take natural resources for granted. （判断句+因果论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We didn't value what we had.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Blinded by the comfort of daily routine, we had long taken for granted the very blessings that others could only dream of. （读后续写·反思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词状语前置(Blinded by...) + take for granted 替换 didn't value + 定语从句(that others could only dream of) 制造对比

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should not think good health is normal.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an age of abundance, it would be gravely mistaken to take good health for granted, for a sound body is the very foundation upon which every ambition is built. （议论文·健康）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 背景状语开头(In an age of abundance) + it would be mistaken to 判断句 + for 引导原因 + 隐喻(foundation upon which...) 升华论点

classPractice.question: He never praises his wife. He just ____________________. 他从不夸妻子，只是觉得她一切理当如此。
classPractice.note: 课件语境应用；take sb for granted 认为某人理所当然（不珍惜）；主语 He 用第三人称单数 takes

classPractice.question: We all ______________________ they had completed their task. 我们都想当然地认为他们已经完成了他们的任务。
classPractice.note: 课件语境应用；take it for granted that + 从句，it 为形式宾语，真宾语为 that 从句；此处叙述过去用 took

classPractice.question: Human beings __________________ that their brains held all the solutions, but maybe their hearts can be a better guide. （以为它理所当然）

classPractice.question: Now, we scientists take ____ for granted that it is perfectly possible to live and not know.

classPractice.question: 只有搬到国外后，她才不再把母亲做的饭菜视为理所当然。Only after moving abroad ____ she stop ____ her mother's meals ____ granted.

original_sentence: But our freedom to doubt was born out of a deep and strong struggle against authority in the early days of science.
readingExamples: But our freedom to doubt was born out of a deep and strong struggle against authority in the early days of science.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the state of being free and allowed to do, say or think what you want without being controlled or restricted
(2) n. the state of not being a prisoner or slave; liberty
(3) n. freedom from sth : the state of not being affected by something unpleasant or unwanted
(4) n. the right or ability to move, act or use something without limitation

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (城市授予的)荣誉市民称号，荣誉自由权
uncommonMeanings.example: In recognition of his lifelong service to the community, the old doctor was granted the freedom of the city — a rare honour that brought tears to his weathered eyes. （读后续写·荣誉时刻）

posExamples.sentence: The instant the cage door swung open, the wounded eagle hesitated, then spread its ragged wings and soared skyward, tasting a freedom it had almost forgotten. （读后续写·放归/重生）
I firmly believe that the freedom to choose our own after-school clubs would greatly boost students' enthusiasm and sense of belonging. （应用文·建议信）
True freedom does not mean doing whatever one pleases; rather, it lies in the discipline to do what one ought, unbound by fear or ignorance. （议论文·哲理思辨）
For the first time in years she felt the sweet freedom of an empty afternoon, with nowhere to rush and no one to answer to. （读后续写·内心舒展）

wordForms.other: 构词法：形容词 free 加名词后缀 -dom → freedom（自由）；同类 -dom 名词：king→kingdom（王国）、wise→wisdom（智慧）、bore→boredom（无聊）。free 一词多用：adj. 自由的/免费的/空闲的；v. 释放（free the prisoner）；短语 free of charge 免费、feel free to do 尽管做

idioms.example: Freedom of speech, once a distant dream, had finally become a right the young journalist was willing to defend at any cost. （理想坚守）
The war hero was awarded the freedom of the city amid the cheers of a grateful crowd. （凯旋）

collocations.translation: 我们质疑的自由（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: But our freedom to doubt was born out of a deep and strong struggle against authority in the early days of science. （课文原句）
The right to freedom of thought lies at the very heart of every great scientific breakthrough. （科学）
Giving children the freedom to explore their interests ignites a lifelong love of learning. （教育）
What the travellers longed for most was a single night of freedom from worry and fear. （旅途）
After ten long years, the falsely accused man finally won his freedom. （平反）
As the bicycle picked up speed down the hill, a wild sense of freedom surged through her. （青春/骑行）
Wise parents grant their children just enough freedom to learn from their mistakes. （家教）
Excessive rules can restrict students' freedom to think creatively. （教育制度）
Freedom of the press serves as a mirror in which a society can examine itself. （媒体）
Only when we cherish the freedom we enjoy today can we understand its price. （历史反思）

synonyms.example: The statue stood tall against the dawn, a timeless emblem of liberty. （象征描写）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：liberty 更正式、庄重，多用于政治、法律或崇高语境（the Statue of Liberty）；freedom 用法更广，日常与抽象皆可，且能接 to do / of / from 结构（freedom to doubt, freedom of speech, freedom from fear）

synonyms.example: Moving into her first apartment gave her a thrilling sense of independence. （成长）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'不依赖他人/不受他方支配'；freedom 侧重'不受限制、可自主行动'

synonyms.example: Granting local schools greater autonomy can encourage innovative teaching. （教育管理）
synonyms.usage: 书面、学术，指'自我管理的权利'，多用于组织或制度层面；freedom 更普适、更情感化

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·freedom 三大搭配结构
advancedExpressions.expression: freedom to do sth（做某事的自由）/ freedom of sth（某方面的自由）/ freedom from sth（免于……的自由）
advancedExpressions.example: 课文 freedom to doubt（质疑的自由）；freedom of speech/thought（言论/思想自由）；freedom from fear/want（免于恐惧/匮乏的自由）。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「自由」（可替换名词）
advancedExpressions.expression: freedom / liberty / independence
advancedExpressions.example: 表达'为自由而战'：fight for freedom / liberty；表达'渴望自主'多用 independence。

advancedExpressions.expression: free → freedom; king → kingdom; wise → wisdom; bore → boredom
advancedExpressions.example: 加 -dom 常构成抽象名词或表状态/领域：freedom（自由）、wisdom（智慧）、boredom（无聊）、kingdom（王国）。

advancedExpressions.expression: in that instant, sb tasted true freedom
advancedExpressions.example: In that instant, standing barefoot on the vast open shore, she tasted true freedom — the kind no wall could ever cage. （破折号补充定义+隐喻）

advancedExpressions.expression: granting students the freedom to ... would ...
advancedExpressions.example: Granting students the freedom to design part of their own curriculum would unleash genuine enthusiasm. （动名词主语+插入语）

advancedExpressions.expression: freedom without responsibility is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Freedom without responsibility is merely chaos in disguise. （对偶+隐喻，思辨深刻）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bird was free at last.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With one final beat of its healed wings, the sparrow burst from my open palms into the boundless blue, and in that heartbeat I understood that freedom, once given, is the greatest gift of all. （读后续写·放生升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 介词短语开头(With one final beat...) + 动作特写(burst from...into) + 插入议论(freedom, once given, is...) 由景入情

sentenceUpgrade.original: Freedom is important for society.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: History bears eloquent witness to a simple truth: no society has ever flourished for long once the freedom to question and to dissent was silenced. （议论文·历史论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化主语(History bears witness) + 冒号引出论点 + no...ever...once 强调结构 + 平行不定式(to question and to dissent)

classPractice.question: Our ____ (free) to doubt was born out of a strong struggle against authority in the early days of science.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；形容词 free 加 -dom 变名词 freedom，作句子主语

classPractice.question: Everyone should enjoy freedom ____ (of / to / from) fear and freedom of speech.

classPractice.question: 给孩子探索自己兴趣的自由，能点燃他们终生的学习热情。Giving children the ____ ____ ____ their own interests ignites a lifelong love of learning.

original_sentence: But our freedom to doubt was born out of a deep and strong struggle against authority in the early days of science.
readingExamples: But our freedom to doubt was born out of a deep and strong struggle against authority in the early days of science.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the power or right to give orders, make decisions and enforce obedience
(2) n. (usually the authorities) the people or organizations that have official power to make decisions or control an area
(3) n. a person or book whose knowledge or opinion on a subject is widely respected and trusted; an expert
(4) n. official permission to do something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（常用复数 the authorities）当局，官方，主管部门（the local authorities 地方当局）
uncommonMeanings.example: The residents urged the local authorities to repair the dangerous bridge before winter set in. （应用文·建议信）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②权威人士，专家；权威著作（an authority on sth 某方面的权威）
uncommonMeanings.example: Though only nineteen, she was already regarded as a leading authority on ancient coins. （少年天才）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（说话、举止的）威信，气势，令人信服的力量
uncommonMeanings.example: He spoke with such quiet authority that the noisy classroom fell silent within seconds. （人物气场）

posExamples.sentence: The old captain gave the order in a voice of unquestionable authority, and at once every sailor sprang to his post, though the storm roared like a wild beast around them. （读后续写·危难指挥）
I would suggest that we report the broken street lamp to the local authorities without delay, as it poses a real danger to residents at night. （应用文·建议信）
Genuine progress in science depends not on blind submission to authority but on the courage to challenge accepted ideas with evidence and reason. （议论文·科学精神）
As a recognized authority in marine biology, Professor Lin was invited to advise the government on protecting the coral reefs. （应用文·人物介绍/演讲稿）

wordForms.noun: authority (权威/当局); authorization (n. 授权)
wordForms.adjective: authoritative (权威的，可信的) / authoritarian (独裁的，专制的)
wordForms.other: 辨析形容词：authoritative（权威的、可信的，褒义，an authoritative source 权威消息源）vs authoritarian（专制的、独裁的，贬义，an authoritarian regime 独裁政权），仅一字之差、褒贬相反，是高考易混点。名词一词多义：权威/权力/当局(the authorities)/权威人士(an authority on)

idioms.translation: 有可靠消息来源；有把握地说
idioms.example: I have it on good authority that the headmaster will announce a spring trip tomorrow. （校园消息）

collocations.translation: 反抗权威的斗争（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Our freedom to doubt was born out of a deep and strong struggle against authority in the early days of science. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 地方当局，地方政府部门
collocations.example: The local authorities have promised to plant a thousand trees along the riverbank. （新闻报道）
Over the decades he became a world authority on migratory birds. （毕生钻研）
A good leader exercises authority over the team not through fear but through respect. （领导力）
The children were taught to trust the adults in authority whenever they felt unsafe. （校园安全）
The spirit of science lies in the freedom to question authority and test every claim. （科学精神）
She answered the reporters' sharp questions calmly and with authority. （人物风范）
The rescue mission was carried out under the authority of the national emergency committee. （官方报道）
A just society must ensure that no one in power can abuse his authority. （公正）
Respect for authority should never smother our capacity for independent thought. （思辨）

synonyms.example: With great power comes great responsibility. （责任）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：power 泛指'能够支配他人或事物的力量'，范围最广；authority 特指'合法、正式的权力或权威'（have authority over sb），也可指'权威人士/专家'（an authority on sth）和'当局'（the authorities）

synonyms.example: The museum invited a renowned expert to authenticate the painting. （文化活动）
synonyms.usage: 指某领域的专家；当 authority 表'权威人士'时与 expert 同义，但 authority 更强调'其判断具权威性、受公认'（an authority on = a leading expert on）

synonyms.example: The captain kept firm control of the ship even as the waves towered above. （危机）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'掌控、支配的动作或状态'；authority 侧重'拥有支配权的合法资格'

advancedExpressions.expression: the authorities（当局）/ an authority on（……的权威）/ have authority over（对……有权力）/ challenge authority（质疑权威）
advancedExpressions.example: 当局：report to the local authorities；专家：an authority on marine biology；权力：exercise authority over the team；科学精神：question/challenge authority。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「权力/权威」（可替换名词）
advancedExpressions.expression: authority / power / control
advancedExpressions.example: 表达'掌握权力'：have authority / power / control over sth；表'合法权威'首选 authority。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·authority 词族与褒贬辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: authority → authorize (v.) → authorization (n.); authoritative (褒) vs authoritarian (贬)
advancedExpressions.example: 动词 authorize（授权）、名词 authorization（授权）；形容词 authoritative 权威可信（褒）、authoritarian 专制独裁（贬）。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the authorities 复数表'当局'
advancedExpressions.expression: the authorities (pl.) = 官方/主管部门
advancedExpressions.example: 表'当局、官方'时用复数并加定冠词 the authorities，谓语用复数：The authorities have taken action.

advancedExpressions.expression: there was an air of quiet authority about sb
advancedExpressions.example: There was an air of quiet authority about the old man that made even the rowdiest of us fall silent. （there be+抽象名词+定语从句）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would urge the authorities to take immediate action to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would urge the relevant authorities to take immediate action to install safety barriers. （正式呼吁句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: to defer blindly to authority is to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To defer blindly to authority is to surrender the very faculty of reason that makes us human. （不定式主语+隐喻性判断）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The teacher spoke and everyone listened.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment the veteran teacher raised her hand, an unspoken authority settled over the room, and forty restless students fell into a hush so complete you could hear the chalk dust drift. （读后续写·课堂气场）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The moment 引导时间状语从句 + 抽象名词具象化(authority settled over) + so...that 夸张(hear the chalk dust drift) 渲染气氛

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not always believe experts.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Progress has never sprung from an unquestioning worship of authority; on the contrary, it is the daring soul who dares to say 'prove it' who pushes the boundaries of human knowledge. （议论文·科学精神）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 否定倒装式论断 + on the contrary 转折 + 强调句(it is...who) + 直接引语('prove it') 增强感染力

classPractice.question: Our freedom to doubt was born out of a strong struggle against ____ (authoritative) in the early days of science.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处需名词 authority（权威），不是形容词 authoritative

classPractice.question: The dictionary is an ____ (authoritative / authoritarian) source that scholars around the world trust.
classPractice.note: authoritative 权威的、可信的（褒）；authoritarian 专制的（贬），一字之差褒贬相反

classPractice.question: 居民们敦促地方当局在冬天来临前修好这座危桥。The residents urged the local ____ to repair the dangerous bridge.
classPractice.note: 表'当局、官方'用复数 the authorities；此处 authority 的多义之一

translation: vt. & vi. 允许，准许，许可；使有可能 | n. 许可证
original_sentence: Permit us to question—to doubt—to not be sure.
readingExamples: Permit us to question—to doubt—to not be sure.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to allow someone to do something, or to allow something to happen, especially by an official rule or by giving permission
(2) v. permit of sth (formal) : to make something possible; to allow for
(3) v. weather / time / circumstances permitting : if the weather, time, etc. allows it
(4) n. an official document that gives you the right to do something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 许可证，通行证（重音移位：动词 /pəˈmɪt/ 重音在后，名词 /ˈpɜːmɪt/ 重音在前）
uncommonMeanings.example: You need a special permit to fish in this lake. 在这个湖里钓鱼需要一张特别许可证。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: permit of sth（正式）容许，留有余地
uncommonMeanings.example: The rules permit of no exception. 这些规则不容许任何例外。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使有可能，容许(某种情况发生)
uncommonMeanings.example: The narrow mountain trail barely permitted two people to walk side by side, forcing us into a single, cautious file. （读后续写·登山）

posExamples.sentence: The guard hesitated for a long moment, then stepped aside and permitted the trembling refugees to cross the border into safety. （读后续写·危难时刻）
We plan to hold the charity fair in the school playground this Saturday, weather permitting; otherwise it will move to the gymnasium. （应用文·通知）
A truly open society permits its citizens to question, to doubt and even to disagree, for it is through such friction that truth is refined. （议论文·自由与真理）
I am writing to apply for a permit that would allow our club to use the community hall for our weekly rehearsals. （应用文·申请信）

wordForms.other: 重音移位小贴士：动词 permit /pəˈmɪt/ 重音在后，名词 permit /ˈpɜːmɪt/ 重音在前——名转动/动转名的典型 'record, present, object' 家族成员。构词：permit(准许)→permission(许可,名词)→permissible(允许的,adj)；双写规则：permit→permitted→permitting(重读闭音节末尾单辅音双写)。

idioms.example: Weather permitting, we shall set off at dawn to catch the first light over the valley. （读后续写·出行计划）
Time permitting, I would love to visit the old bookshop tucked away in that quiet alley. （读后续写·日常愿望）

collocations.translation: 【课件】允许某人做某事（课文原句：Permit us to question...）
collocations.example: Permit us to question—to doubt—to not be sure. 允许我们质疑、怀疑、不确定。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】允许做某事（permit 后无宾语时接动名词）
collocations.example: We do not permit smoking in the office. 在我们的办公室里不准吸烟。（课件语境）

collocations.phrase: sb be not permitted to do sth
collocations.example: As a punishment, she was not permitted to attend any school activities. 作为惩罚，她不被允许参加学校的任何活动。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】如果时间／天气允许（独立主格作状语，句首无 if）
collocations.example: Time permitting, I'll definitely pay you a visit. 如果时间允许，我一定去拜访你。（课件原句，由 If time permits 改写而来）

collocations.translation: 【课件】工作／旅游／居住许可证（permit 作名词）
collocations.example: Without a valid work permit, he could not take the job. 没有有效的工作许可证，他无法接受这份工作。

collocations.translation: 【课件】报请批准（permission n. 准许，许可）
collocations.example: You must ask permission for any change to the schedule. 对日程的任何改动都必须报请批准。
Only staff have permission to enter this room. 只有工作人员才获准进入这个房间。
No one may leave the exam hall without permission. 未经允许，任何人不得离开考场。

collocations.translation: 允许某人做某事（课文原句：Permit us to question—to doubt—to not be sure. 允许我们提问、怀疑、不确定。）
collocations.example: Permit us to question—to doubt—to not be sure. 允许我们提问、怀疑、不必确信。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 天气/时间/情况允许的话（独立主格结构，作状语，句首无连词、无 if）
collocations.example: Weather permitting, we will hold the sports meeting on Friday. 如果天气允许，运动会将在周五举行。

collocations.translation: 允许做某事（permit 后接动名词，无宾语时）
collocations.example: The school does not permit smoking anywhere on campus. 学校不允许在校园任何地方吸烟。

collocations.translation: 工作/停车/建筑许可证（此处 permit 为名词，重音前移 /ˈpɜːmɪt/）
collocations.example: Without a valid work permit, he could not take the job. 没有有效工作许可证，他无法接受这份工作。
School regulations do not permit the use of mobile phones during class hours. （应用文·校规）
Time permitting, we will also visit the local museum after lunch. （应用文·行程安排）
Visitors are permitted to take photographs, provided that no flash is used. （应用文·参观须知）
Before starting the rooftop garden project, the students had to apply for a permit from the school office. （应用文·申请）
If circumstances permit, we intend to extend the volunteer programme to nearby villages as well. （应用文·计划）
The evidence was so overwhelming that it permitted of no doubt whatsoever. （议论文·论证 / 正式书面）

synonyms.example: Please allow me to introduce our special guest for this evening's concert. （应用文·主持稿）
synonyms.usage: 最通用、最口语；permit 更正式，多用于规则、官方或书面语境

synonyms.example: Only the headmaster is authorized to approve such a large expenditure. （应用文·公文）
synonyms.usage: 强调'正式授予权力/批准'，主体多为机构或权威；permit 侧重'准许某行为发生'

synonyms.example: The scholarship enabled her to pursue her dream of studying abroad. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'赋予能力或创造条件使成为可能'，不含'许可'之意；permit 表'使有可能'时较正式且偏被动条件

advancedExpressions.expression: permit sb to do sth / permit doing sth / be permitted to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: 对比记忆：permit sb to do（有宾语用不定式）；permit doing（无宾语用动名词）；被动 be permitted to do。如 Students are not permitted to leave / The rules permit smoking only outdoors.

advancedExpressions.expression: weather / time / circumstances permitting
advancedExpressions.example: 独立主格结构，permitting 前有自己的逻辑主语（weather），整体作状语，等于 if the weather permits，句首不加 if 也不加连词。如 Weather permitting, the ceremony will be held outdoors.

advancedExpressions.expression: permit(v.准许) → permission(n.许可) → permissible(adj.可允许的)
advancedExpressions.example: ask for permission 请求许可 / give sb permission to do 允许某人做 / It is not permissible to park here.

advancedExpressions.expression: as soon as circumstances permitted, sb ...
advancedExpressions.example: As soon as circumstances permitted, he slipped quietly out of the crowded hall and hurried toward the hospital where his mother lay waiting. （时间状语从句+动作串联，续写推进情节）

advancedExpressions.expression: weather permitting, the event will take place ...
advancedExpressions.example: Weather permitting, the outdoor art exhibition will take place on the front lawn this Sunday afternoon. （独立分词短语，通知类地道简洁）

advancedExpressions.expression: a healthy society is one that permits ...
advancedExpressions.example: A healthy society is one that permits dissent, welcomes debate and treats every honest question as a step toward truth. （定义式判断+三动词平行，论点鲜明）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The path was too narrow for two people.

readingExamples: It is our responsibility as scientists, knowing the great progress that is the fruit of freedom of thought, to declare the value of this freedom.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a duty to deal with or take care of somebody or something, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong
(2) n. the state of being accountable or to blame for something
(3) n. a moral obligation to behave correctly towards or in respect of someone or something
(4) n. (often responsibilities) a task or duty that you are required or expected to do as part of a job or role

posExamples.sentence: When the youngest climber slipped, the guide felt the full weight of responsibility press down on his shoulders, and without a word he began the perilous descent to reach her. （读后续写·担当时刻）

Protecting the environment is not the responsibility of the government alone; it is a shared duty that rests upon the shoulders of each and every one of us. （议论文·环保）
Though the mistake was not entirely his own, he stepped forward and took full responsibility, and in that honest moment he earned everyone's quiet respect. （读后续写·品格）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：responsibility(n.责任) — responsible(adj.负责的,有责任心的) — responsibly(adv.负责地)。搭配辨析：be responsible for sth/doing（对……负责）≈ take responsibility for sth；a responsible person 有责任心的人；the person responsible 责任人（形容词后置定语）。复数 responsibilities 多指'具体职责'。

collocations.translation: 责任感（不可数，sense of + 抽象名词）
