collocations.phrase: have a responsibility to do sth
collocations.example: We all have a responsibility to protect the vulnerable and to speak up when we witness injustice. （议论文·社会责任）

collocations.phrase: the responsibility rests / lies with sb
collocations.example: Ultimately, the responsibility for a child's moral upbringing lies with the family as much as the school. （议论文·教育）
The young engineer bravely shouldered the responsibility of redesigning the faulty bridge overnight. （读后续写·担当）
Blaming others is simply a way of shirking the responsibility we ought to face ourselves. （议论文·品德）

synonyms.example: It is the duty of every student to keep our shared classroom clean and tidy. （应用文·倡议）

synonyms.example: The heavy burden of supporting the whole family fell upon his young shoulders. （读后续写·艰辛）

translation: 表明，宣称；公布，宣布；申报
original_sentence: It is our responsibility as scientists, knowing the great progress that is the fruit of freedom of thought, to declare the value of this freedom.
readingExamples: It is our responsibility as scientists, knowing the great progress that is the fruit of freedom of thought, to declare the value of this freedom.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to state something officially or publicly, especially in a formal or definite way
(2) vt. to say something firmly and clearly, often to express a strong opinion or feeling
(3) vt. to make a written statement of goods, income, etc. on which tax must be paid (e.g. at customs)
(4) vt. to officially announce the beginning of a state or condition, such as war, independence or a result

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （在海关）申报（应纳税物品）；（纳税时）申报（收入）
uncommonMeanings.example: You must declare all goods that exceed the duty-free limit. 你必须申报所有超过免税限额的物品。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （打牌）摊牌，亮牌；（板球）宣布提前结束一局
uncommonMeanings.example: With a triumphant grin, he laid his cards face up on the table and declared, certain that no hand could beat his own. （读后续写·牌局·胜负关头）

posExamples.sentence: Rising to her feet before the hushed hall, the trembling girl finally declared that she, and no one else, had painted the prize-winning picture, her voice steadier with every word. （读后续写·真相揭晓·勇气）
On behalf of the whole student union, I hereby declare that our reading week has been an overwhelming success, and I sincerely thank every volunteer who made it possible. （应用文·致辞/总结发言）
Many educators boldly declare that examinations kill creativity; yet a fair assessment, far from stifling talent, can actually motivate students to reach beyond their comfort zone. （议论文·教育与考试）
Passengers arriving from abroad are required to declare any goods that exceed the duty-free limit, or they may face a heavy fine at customs. （应用文·须知/告示）

wordForms.other: 词族：declare(v.宣布/申报) → declaration(n.宣言,声明；the Declaration of Independence《独立宣言》) → declarative(adj.陈述的,declarative sentence 陈述句)。构词：de-(向下/彻底)+clare(=clear 清楚)→'讲清楚'即'宣布'。

idioms.example: That morning she quietly declared war on her own laziness, setting the alarm an hour earlier and lacing up her running shoes before dawn. （读后续写·自我突破·比喻用法）

collocations.example: The government declared a state of emergency following the tsunami. 海啸过后，政府宣布进入紧急状态。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】宣布／宣称……（to state officially and publicly）
collocations.example: The court declared that Brown's case should be reviewed. 法庭宣布要对布朗的案子进行复查。（课件原句）
She was declared (to be) guilty. 她被宣判有罪。The area has been declared (to be) a national park. 这一地区已被宣布为国家公园。（课件原句）
He declared himself innocent. 他声称自己是无罪的。（课件原句）
Most people declared for peace and against war. 大多数人声明拥护和平，反对战争。（课件原句）
I declare this bridge open. 我宣布这座大桥正式启用。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 宣称/表明……（课文原句词块，此处为 declare + 宾语的正式表态）
collocations.example: It is our responsibility ... to declare the value of this freedom. ……我们的责任……是宣示这种自由的价值。（课文原句）
The two countries declared war on each other. 两国相互宣战。

collocations.translation: 有什么要申报的吗？（海关用语，declare = 报关申报）
collocations.example: "Anything to declare?" the customs officer asked. "有什么要申报的吗？"海关人员问道。

The colony declared its independence after years of struggle, and the news spread like wildfire across the land. （议论文·历史叙述）
The judges unanimously declared her essay to be the finest they had read in a decade. （读后续写·比赛结果）
As the flood waters kept rising, the government declared a state of emergency and dispatched rescue teams overnight. （应用文·新闻报道）
Honest travellers always declare valuable items at customs rather than risk being caught smuggling. （议论文·诚信）
Under the flickering streetlight, he finally summoned the courage to declare his feelings, his cheeks burning red. （读后续写·情感·表白）
She openly declared her opposition to the plan, unafraid of the frowns it drew from the committee. （议论文·立场）

synonyms.example: The principal announced that classes would be suspended because of the approaching typhoon. （应用文·通知）

synonyms.example: With arms flung wide, he proclaimed to the empty valley that he would never give up. （读后续写·情感爆发）
synonyms.usage: 语气最强、最富戏剧性和感情色彩，多用于郑重或激昂的公开宣告；比 'declare' 更文学化

synonyms.example: The scientist firmly asserted that the data left no room for doubt. （议论文·论证）
synonyms.usage: 侧重不容置疑地坚持某观点，含'即使无充分证据也坚持'的意味；'declare' 更偏正式公开的表态

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·demand 需要/强烈要求（课件同框讲点）

advancedExpressions.example: 课件讲点：This sport demands both speed and strength.（需要）/ The UN has demanded that all troops be withdrawn.（强烈要求，that 从句虚拟 (should) be）/ I demand to see the manager.（坚决要求做）。注：课文 to demand this freedom 与 declare 同句并列，故与 demand 同框辨析。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·declare 一词多场景
advancedExpressions.expression: declare war / independence / a state of emergency / goods at customs

advancedExpressions.expression: declare(v.) → declaration(n.) → declarative(adj.)

synonyms.example: After living in the country for a decade, he finally applied for citizenship. （应用文·说明）

synonyms.example: The survey asked respondents about their ethnicity to better understand cultural diversity. （应用文·调查）
synonyms.usage: 特指种族／族裔文化背景，不涉及国籍法律；'nationality' 在'民族'义上与之接近，但更常指国家层面

synonyms.example: A nation is bound together not only by borders but by a shared story and shared dreams. （议论文·国家认同）
synonyms.usage: 指'国家'或作为整体的'民族'实体本身；'nationality' 是抽象的'国籍／民族身份'属性

advancedExpressions.expression: nation → national → nationality → nationwide → nationalize

advancedExpressions.expression: of ... nationality / dual nationality / regardless of nationality
advancedExpressions.example: 填表 Nationality: Chinese；of British nationality 英国籍；dual nationality 双重国籍；regardless of nationality 不分国籍——高考应用文/议论文包容主题高频。

advancedExpressions.expression: beyond the label of nationality, sb. found ...

original_sentence: He put forward the theory of evolution by natural selection and published On the Origin of Species in 1859.
readingExamples: He put forward the theory of evolution by natural selection and published On the Origin of Species in 1859.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to suggest a plan, idea, theory or proposal for others to consider and discuss
(2) phr. v. to formally recommend or nominate someone for a position, honour or duty
(3) phr. v. to move an event, meeting or deadline to an earlier time or date (chiefly British English)
(4) phr. v. to move the hands of a clock or watch to a later time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把（活动、时间）提前（英式；反义是 put off 推迟）
uncommonMeanings.example: Because a storm was forecast, the organisers put the sports meeting forward to Friday. 因预报有暴风雨，主办方把运动会提前到了周五。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 推荐，提名（某人担任职位/荣誉）
uncommonMeanings.example: The teachers put her forward for the role of head prefect. 老师们推荐她担任学生会主席。

posExamples.sentence: When everyone else fell silent, the timid boy at the back slowly raised his hand and put forward an idea so simple yet so brilliant that the whole classroom broke into applause. （读后续写·灵光一现·转折）
I am writing to put forward a proposal that our school set aside one afternoon each week for students to volunteer in the local community. （应用文·建议信）
Critics have put forward the argument that social media isolates us; however, the same tools, wisely used, can weave bonds across oceans. （议论文·观点交锋）
The teachers unanimously put her forward for the role of head prefect, confident that her patience and integrity would inspire the younger students. （读后续写·推荐·信任）

wordForms.other: 短语动词，无词形变化，主体动词 put 三态同形（put-put-put，现在分词 putting 双写 t）。put 短语群横向拓展：put forward 提出 / put off 推迟 / put up with 忍受 / put up 张贴,搭建,留宿 / put out 熄灭 / put aside 存放,搁置 / put down 放下,记下,镇压。可分性：put a plan forward = put forward a plan（宾语为代词时必须分开：put it forward，不可 put forward it）。

collocations.phrase: put forward the theory / an idea
collocations.translation: 提出理论／想法（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He put forward the theory of evolution by natural selection ... 他提出了自然选择的进化论……（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 被提出（put forward 可用于被动语态）
collocations.example: A bold proposal was put forward at the meeting. 会上提出了一项大胆的提案。
She put forward a proposal to recycle old textbooks, and it was warmly received by the committee. （应用文·建议信）
The debater put forward a compelling argument that left her opponents scrambling for a reply. （议论文·辩论）
The volunteers put forward a plan to clean up the riverbank every Saturday morning. （应用文·活动方案）
His classmates put him forward as their spokesman, trusting his calm and clear voice. （读后续写·推举）
Several members put forward the same name for the award, a rare show of agreement. （应用文·会议记录）
Rather than merely complaining, the students put forward a practical solution to ease the lunchtime crowding. （议论文·解决问题）

synonyms.example: I would like to propose that we hold a charity book sale next month. （应用文·建议信）
synonyms.usage: 较正式的单词，直接跟名词或 that 从句均可；'put forward' 是地道短语动词，口语与书面皆宜，语气略活泼

synonyms.example: She suggested inviting a guest speaker to the club meeting. （应用文·建议）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、语气最委婉；'put forward' 更强调'正式地提出以供讨论'，多用于计划、理论、论点等较'成型'的内容

synonyms.example: The professor advanced a bold hypothesis that challenged decades of belief. （议论文·学术）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面语，多与 theory/argument/idea 搭配，语域偏高；与 'put forward' 在'提出理论'义上可互换，但更文雅

synonyms.example: A parent raised the question of safety during the field trip. （应用文·会议）
synonyms.usage: 多用于提出'问题、疑问、话题'，侧重'引起注意'；'put forward' 侧重提出'方案、观点'供采纳

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:提出观点/方案(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: put forward / propose / advance / raise / come up with
advancedExpressions.example: 提方案观点：put forward ≈ propose ≈ advance(偏学术,advance a theory)；come up with 想出(口语)；raise 侧重提出'问题'（raise a question）。写作换词避免重复：Some put forward the view that ... = Some propose / advance the idea that ...

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·put forward 的被动与可分性
advancedExpressions.expression: A theory was put forward = Sb put forward a theory
advancedExpressions.example: 被动：The theory of evolution was put forward by Darwin. 可分：put the plan forward / put forward the plan 均可，但代词宾语必须插中间——put it forward（√）put forward it（×）。

advancedExpressions.expression: put forward / put off / put up with / put out / put aside
advancedExpressions.example: put forward 提出↔put off 推迟；put up with 忍受；put out 熄灭；put aside 搁置/储蓄。一个 put 变换介副词，义项全然不同——高考完形/语填高频。

advancedExpressions.expression: gathering every ounce of courage, sb. put forward ...
advancedExpressions.example: Gathering every ounce of courage, the new student put forward an idea that no one had dared to voice, and silence gave way to nods of approval. （分词状语铺垫心理，凸显'从怯懦到发声'的转变）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would like to put forward the following suggestions ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would like to put forward the following suggestions, which I believe will make our campus both greener and more enjoyable. （建议信标准过渡句，非限制性定语从句补充意图）

advancedExpressions.expression: while some put forward the view that ..., I would argue that ...
advancedExpressions.example: While some put forward the view that hardship should be avoided at all costs, I would argue that it is precisely through adversity that character is forged. （让步+主张，先立他人观点再反驳）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He suggested a new idea and everyone liked it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Hesitant at first, he finally put forward a fresh idea, and the murmurs of doubt around the table melted into an eager buzz of agreement. （读后续写·氛围转变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语（Hesitant at first）刻画心理 + put forward 替换口语 suggested 显庄重 + 隐喻（murmurs melted into a buzz）动态呈现群体反应

sentenceUpgrade.original: We want to give the school some suggestions about the canteen.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On behalf of the student council, I am writing to put forward several constructive suggestions concerning our school canteen, in the hope that dining here will become a pleasure rather than a chore. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: On behalf of... 表明身份提升正式度 + put forward constructive suggestions 固定书面搭配 + in the hope that... 目的状语点明善意用心

classPractice.question: Darwin put forward the theory of evolution. → The theory of evolution ____ ____ ____ by Darwin.
classPractice.note: put forward 变被动，put 过去分词仍是 put，故 was put forward；by Darwin 保留施动者

classPractice.note: put up with 忍受；put forward 提出、put off 推迟，语境定唯一答案

classPractice.answer: I would like to put forward the following suggestions.
classPractice.note: put forward suggestions 提建议，建议信主体高频句；suggestions 后可接同位/定语从句

original_sentence: He put forward the theory of evolution by natural selection and published On the Origin of Species in 1859.
readingExamples: He put forward the theory of evolution by natural selection and published On the Origin of Species in 1859.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the scientific theory that the different kinds of living things developed gradually from earlier and simpler forms over millions of years
(2) n. the gradual development and change of something over a period of time
(3) n. the process of a particular situation, idea or organization slowly changing and becoming more complex or advanced

posExamples.sentence: Looking back over the yellowed photographs, she saw the quiet evolution of her own courage — from the frightened child in the corner to the woman now standing tall before a thousand strangers. （读后续写·成长回望·蜕变）
In my report, I will trace the evolution of our school library, from a single dusty shelf to the bright, well-stocked reading centre we are proud of today. （应用文·报告）
The evolution of artificial intelligence, though breathtaking, urges us to ask a deeper question: are we shaping the machines, or are they quietly reshaping us? （议论文·科技反思）
Darwin's theory of evolution by natural selection transformed the way humankind understands its own place in the living world. （议论文·科学史）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：evolution(n.进化,演变) — evolve(v.进化,逐渐发展,evolve from/into) — evolutionary(adj.进化的,evolutionary theory 进化论) — evolutionist(n.进化论者) — evolutionarily(adv.)。构词：e-(=ex-向外)+volv/volut(=roll 卷,滚动)→'向外展开'即'演化'；同根 revolve 旋转、involve 卷入、revolution 革命/公转。搭配辨析：evolve from（从……进化而来）/ evolve into（演变成）。

collocations.phrase: the theory of evolution (by natural selection)
collocations.translation: （自然选择的）进化论（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He put forward the theory of evolution by natural selection ... 他提出了通过自然选择的进化论……（课文原句）
The museum's exhibition vividly showed the evolution of the mobile phone over three short decades. （应用文·参观介绍）
Fossils found in that cave shed fresh light on the long story of human evolution. （议论文·科普）

collocations.phrase: natural selection / evolution by natural selection
collocations.translation: 自然选择／通过自然选择的进化
collocations.example: Through natural selection, the creatures best suited to their surroundings survived and passed on their traits. （议论文·生物）
Her writing style underwent a gradual evolution, growing richer and more confident with every essay. （读后续写·成长）
The process of evolution works over spans of time far greater than any single human life. （议论文·科学）
The festival reflects the slow social evolution of a village that has kept its soul while embracing change. （议论文·文化）

synonyms.example: The teacher praised the steady development of his reading skills over the term. （应用文·评语）
synonyms.usage: 最通用，泛指任何'发展、成长'，可快可慢；'evolution' 强调'长期、渐进、由简到繁'的自然演变，语域更学术

synonyms.example: The nation has made remarkable progress in lifting people out of poverty. （议论文·社会）
synonyms.usage: 含明确的'向好、向前'的价值判断；'evolution' 本身中性，只描述'演变'，不必然表示变好

synonyms.example: The shy boy's transformation into a confident leader amazed all his teachers. （读后续写·蜕变）
synonyms.usage: 强调'剧烈、彻底'的改变，常在短时间内完成；'evolution' 侧重缓慢、连续、层层累积的变化

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·volv/volut 词根家族(=roll 卷)
advancedExpressions.expression: evolution ↔ evolve ↔ revolve / involve / revolution
advancedExpressions.example: e-(外)+volv→evolve 向外展开=演化；re-(back)+volve→revolve 旋转/公转→revolution 革命；in-(进)+volve→involve 卷入。一根 volv 串起'转/卷'的意象网。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表'演变/发展'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: evolution / development / transformation / progress
advancedExpressions.example: evolution 缓慢渐进、由简到繁(学术中性)；development 泛指发展(最通用)；transformation 剧烈彻底的转变；progress 含'向好'价值判断。据语速与褒贬择词。

advancedExpressions.expression: the theory of evolution / evolution by natural selection / the evolution of sth
advancedExpressions.example: 进化论 the theory of evolution；自然选择进化 evolution by natural selection；某物的演变 the evolution of technology/language——科学史+科技反思两大高考话题必备。

advancedExpressions.expression: what she witnessed was nothing less than the evolution of ...
advancedExpressions.example: What she witnessed in that faded diary was nothing less than the evolution of a broken girl into a woman who had learned to forgive. （nothing less than 强化+抽象名词具象化，点明蜕变主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: the evolution of ... over the past ... bears witness to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The evolution of our recycling programme over the past three years bears witness to what a handful of determined students can achieve. （'bear witness to' 拟人化，庄重呈现成果）

advancedExpressions.expression: the evolution of ... is not merely ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The evolution of technology is not merely a story of faster machines, but a mirror reflecting humanity's endless hunger to reach beyond itself. （not merely...but...递进+比喻升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Over the years he changed a lot and became braver.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Over the years, an almost imperceptible evolution took place within him: fear loosened its grip finger by finger, until the boy who once trembled at every shadow could look the world calmly in the eye. （读后续写·渐变+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词 evolution 作主语，将'变化'实体化 + 冒号引出具体展开 + 拟人（fear loosened its grip）+ 副词短语（finger by finger）刻画渐进感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our club has grown and improved a lot since it started.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Since its humble beginnings two years ago, our photography club has undergone a remarkable evolution, blossoming from a group of five curious beginners into a thriving community of over a hundred passionate members. （应用文·社团汇报）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: undergo a remarkable evolution 正式搭配替换 grow + 分词状语（blossoming from...into...）+ 具体数字对比（five→over a hundred）增强说服力

classPractice.question: Darwin's theory of ____ (evolve) by natural selection changed how humans understand life.
classPractice.note: 空前 theory of 需名词；evolve → evolution（进化，演变）

classPractice.note: evolve from 从……进化而来；现在完成 have evolved，注意 evolve 去 e 加 ed

classPractice.note: the evolution of sth 某物的演变，介词固定为 of

original_sentence: He put forward the theory of evolution by natural selection and published On the Origin of Species in 1859.
readingExamples: He put forward the theory of evolution by natural selection and published On the Origin of Species in 1859.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to prepare and produce a book, magazine, newspaper, etc. and make it available to the public for sale
(2) vt. to make information, a piece of writing or a set of results available to the public, especially by printing it or putting it online
(3) vt. (of a writer) to have one's work printed and offered to the public
(4) vt. to officially announce something, such as a set of official figures, an apology or a notice

posExamples.sentence: The morning her first short story was published, she clutched the fresh newspaper to her chest, and years of quiet rejection suddenly seemed to melt away like frost in the sun. （读后续写·梦想成真·情感）
We are delighted to inform you that the school magazine will publish your prize-winning essay in next month's issue, and we sincerely invite you to attend the release ceremony. （应用文·通知信）
When researchers publish their findings openly, they invite the whole world to test, challenge and build upon their work — and this, in essence, is how science advances. （议论文·科学精神）
After months of doubt, Darwin finally published On the Origin of Species, a book that would forever change how humanity understood life itself. （议论文·科学史）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：publish(v.出版,发表) — publication(n.出版；出版物,a monthly publication 月刊) — publisher(n.出版商,出版社) — published/unpublished(adj.已/未出版的)。注意区分：publish(出版发表) vs. public(adj.公共的)/publicity(n.宣传,曝光)/publicize(v.宣传) 同根 publ-(=people 公众,'公之于众')。get sth published 为 get + 宾语 + 过去分词（使役被动）。

collocations.phrase: publish a book / On the Origin of Species
collocations.translation: 出版一本书（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He ... published On the Origin of Species in 1859. 他……于1859年出版了《物种起源》。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 出版书籍／小说／发表文章
collocations.example: At just nineteen, she published her first novel, and the world took notice. （读后续写·成就）

collocations.translation: 公布结果／发表研究成果
collocations.example: The team published their findings in a leading journal, sparking debate around the globe. （议论文·科研）
Her poem was published in the school magazine, and she read it aloud with trembling pride. （读后续写·荣誉）
The club publishes its weekly newsletter online so that every member can read it for free. （应用文·说明）
The newspaper published a public apology after admitting its report had been mistaken. （议论文·媒体责任）
The committee published a detailed report on how the charity funds had been spent. （应用文·报告）
It took her ten years of persistence to get her first book published. （读后续写·坚持）

synonyms.example: The band released their new album at midnight, and fans downloaded it in their millions. （应用文·新闻）
synonyms.usage: 泛指向公众'放出'任何产品（唱片、电影、软件、消息等）；'publish' 特指文字／出版物或正式信息的公开发表

synonyms.example: The government issued new guidelines on road safety. （应用文·公告）
synonyms.usage: 多用于官方'颁发、发行'（文件、声明、邮票、货币等），带官方色彩；'publish' 更常指出版物与研究成果的公开

synonyms.example: The magazine printed her letter in full. （应用文·说明）
synonyms.usage: 字面强调'印刷'这一物理动作或'刊登'；'publish' 涵盖从编辑到公开发行的整个过程，意义更完整

synonyms.example: The author brought out a new edition with three extra chapters. （读后续写·叙述）
synonyms.usage: 口语化短语动词，多指作者或出版社'推出'新书；'publish' 更正式，书面语与学术语境皆宜

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:向公众'发布/推出'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: publish / release / issue / bring out / print
advancedExpressions.example: publish 特指文字出版物、研究成果；release 泛指放出产品(唱片/电影/消息)；issue 官方颁发(文件/声明)；bring out 口语'推出新书'；print 强调印刷/刊登。据对象择词。

advancedExpressions.expression: publish → publication → publisher；public → publicity → publicize
advancedExpressions.example: publ-(=people 公众)：publish 公之于众即'出版'，publication 出版物，publisher 出版商；public 公共的，publicity 宣传曝光，publicize 宣传。同根记忆一串。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·get sth published (使役被动)
advancedExpressions.expression: get / have sth published

advancedExpressions.expression: the day her work was finally published marked ...
advancedExpressions.example: The day her first poem was finally published marked not the end of her struggle, but the quiet beginning of a life she had only dared to dream of. （抽象日期作主语+not...but...重定义结局）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are pleased to announce that ... will be published ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are pleased to announce that the winning entries will be published in a special edition, and each author will receive a signed copy as a keepsake. （通知体套语，'we are pleased to announce' 提升正式度）

advancedExpressions.expression: only when ... are openly published can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only when scientific results are openly published and freely questioned can knowledge shake off error and move steadily towards truth. （only 倒装强调条件，凸显公开透明的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Her story was printed in the newspaper and she was very happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When she saw her own story published across two full pages of the morning paper, a warmth she could not name rose in her chest, and for the first time she truly believed that her voice mattered. （读后续写·成就+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: published 替换 printed 提升语域 + 具体细节（across two full pages）增强画面 + 抽象情感具象化（a warmth...rose in her chest）+ 结尾点明主题（her voice mattered）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The school will put the students' best essays in a book.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To celebrate our young writers, the school has decided to publish a collection of the finest student essays, giving every talented voice a well-deserved chance to be heard. （应用文·通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 目的状语前置（To celebrate...）点明用意 + publish a collection 正式搭配替换口语 put...in a book + 现在分词状语（giving...）补充意义，语气温暖得体

classPractice.question: Darwin's most famous ____ (publish), On the Origin of Species, appeared in 1859.
classPractice.note: 空前 most famous 需名词；publish → publication（出版物）

classPractice.question: 她花了十年才使自己的第一本书得以出版。It took her ten years to ____ her first book ____.
classPractice.note: get sth published 使某物被出版（get+宾语+过去分词的使役被动结构）

classPractice.question: The research team ____ (published / released) their findings in a leading scientific journal.
classPractice.note: 发表研究成果/文字于刊物用 publish；release 多指放出唱片、电影、消息等产品

original_sentence: Darwin was such a scientific man that before he made up his mind to get married, he made a careful list of the advantages and disadvantages of marriage.
readingExamples: Darwin was such a scientific man that before he made up his mind to get married, he made a careful list of the advantages and disadvantages of marriage.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the legal or formal relationship between two people who have become husband and wife (or partners); the state of being married
(2) n. the ceremony in which two people are officially united as a married couple; a wedding
(3) n. a close and effective combination or union of two different things, ideas or elements

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 婚礼（仪式，= wedding，此义较少用，多用 wedding）
uncommonMeanings.example: The marriage took place in a small country church. 婚礼在一座乡村小教堂举行。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （两种事物的）紧密结合，融合
uncommonMeanings.example: The old teahouse was a happy marriage of the ancient and the modern, where paper lanterns glowed above quietly humming laptops. （读后续写·环境描写·新旧交融）

posExamples.sentence: On the morning of the marriage, sunlight spilled through the church windows, and the bride's mother wiped away a tear, whispering that her little girl had grown up at last. （读后续写·婚礼场景·亲情）
I am writing to warmly invite you to attend the celebration of my sister's marriage, which will be held at the Riverside Hotel on the first Saturday of June. （应用文·邀请信）
A lasting marriage, many wise couples agree, is built not on the absence of quarrels but on the patience to forgive and the courage to begin again. （议论文·人生与关系）
Before making up his mind, the ever-methodical Darwin drew up a careful list of the advantages and disadvantages of marriage. （议论文·人物轶事）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：marriage(n.婚姻,结婚) — marry(v.结婚,marry sb 与某人结婚) — married(adj.已婚的,be/get married to sb) — marriageable(adj.适婚的)。搭配辨析：marry sb（及物,嫁给/娶某人,不加 with！）/ get married to sb / be married to sb（强调状态）。辨析 marriage vs. wedding：marriage 指'婚姻状态'这一长期关系（幸福婚姻 a happy marriage），wedding 专指'婚礼'这一仪式事件（婚礼庆典 attend a wedding）。

idioms.translation: 权宜的结合；（为利益而非感情的）婚姻／联姻
idioms.example: Their partnership began as a mere marriage of convenience, yet over the years a genuine respect quietly took root between them. （读后续写·关系演变·比喻用法）

collocations.phrase: the advantages and disadvantages of marriage
collocations.translation: 婚姻的利与弊（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He made a careful list of the advantages and disadvantages of marriage. 他仔细列出了婚姻的利与弊。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 在他结婚之前（before + one's marriage，marriage 表'结婚/婚姻'）
collocations.example: Before his marriage, Darwin weighed the pros and cons like a scientist. 结婚前，达尔文像科学家一样权衡利弊。
Their fifty years of a happy marriage were, they insisted, no miracle but the fruit of daily kindness. （读后续写·长辈·感悟）
Under the cherry blossoms, he knelt and proposed marriage, his heart pounding louder than the applause that followed. （读后续写·求婚·画面）
She is my aunt by marriage rather than by blood, yet no one could be dearer to me. （读后续写·亲情）
Some argue that the institution of marriage is fading, while others see it quietly reinventing itself. （议论文·社会观察）
In the old story her parents tried to arrange a marriage she did not want, and so she ran away at dawn. （读后续写·旧时代·冲突）

collocations.translation: 以婚姻的形式，结为夫妻
collocations.example: He asked for her hand in marriage before the whole gathered family. （读后续写·正式场合）

collocations.phrase: the ups and downs of marriage
collocations.example: Having weathered the ups and downs of marriage together, the old couple now finished each other's sentences. （读后续写·相守）
Honest communication, the counsellor said, had saved more than one marriage on the brink of collapse. （议论文·关系）

synonyms.example: Guests danced late into the night at the joyful wedding. （读后续写·庆典）
synonyms.usage: 专指举行婚礼的'仪式、庆典'这一事件；'marriage' 既可指婚礼，更常指'婚姻状态'这一长期关系，含义更广

synonyms.example: The couple were joined in holy matrimony before the altar. （读后续写·庄严场面）
synonyms.usage: 非常正式、庄重甚至带宗教色彩的书面用语，多见于仪式或法律语境；'marriage' 通用、日常

synonyms.example: Their union brought together two families that had long been strangers. （议论文·叙述）
synonyms.usage: 泛指'结合、联合'，语气典雅含蓄，可指婚姻也可指其他结合；在婚姻义上比 'marriage' 更文雅委婉

synonyms.example: The two children were born in wedlock. （应用文·法律说明）
synonyms.usage: 偏旧式、法律用语，多见于 'in / out of wedlock'（婚生／非婚生）；日常口语几乎只用 'marriage'

advancedExpressions.expression: marriage(婚姻状态,长期关系) ↔ wedding(婚礼,一场仪式)
advancedExpressions.example: a happy marriage 幸福的婚姻（关系）；attend a wedding 参加婚礼（仪式）。谈'白头偕老/婚姻制度'用 marriage，谈'那天的典礼'用 wedding。

advancedExpressions.expression: marry(v.) → marriage(n.) → married(adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: marry sb 娶/嫁某人（及物，不加 with）；get married to sb 与某人结婚；be married 已婚。名词 marriage 由 marry + -age(名词后缀)构成。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:'婚姻/结合'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: marriage / wedding / union / matrimony / wedlock
advancedExpressions.example: wedding 婚礼仪式；union 典雅委婉'结合/联姻'；matrimony 庄重正式(带宗教色彩)；wedlock 旧式法律用语(in/out of wedlock)。据语域与所指择词。

advancedExpressions.expression: their marriage had weathered ..., and out of it grew ...
advancedExpressions.example: Their marriage had weathered poverty, illness and years of separation, and out of that long endurance grew a tenderness that no words could ever fully capture. （三项并列铺陈磨难+out of...grew 倒装凸显升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: it would be our greatest honour if you could join us to celebrate the marriage of ...
advancedExpressions.example: It would be our greatest honour if you could join us to celebrate the marriage of our dear friends, whose love has warmed everyone around them. （邀请信敬语句式，非限制定语从句添情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: a marriage, like ..., thrives not on ... but on ...
advancedExpressions.example: A marriage, like a garden, thrives not on grand declarations but on the small, patient acts of care repeated day after day. （明喻+not...but...精辟点题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They got married and were happy together for many years.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Their marriage, which began with a modest ceremony in a tiny village church, blossomed over the decades into a bond so deep that a single glance could carry a whole conversation. （读后续写·关系深化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词 marriage 作主语 + 非限制定语从句（which began...）补背景 + 动词 blossomed 比喻化+夸张细节（a glance carried a conversation）传达默契

sentenceUpgrade.original: I want to invite you to my brother's wedding.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I would be truly delighted if you could grace us with your presence at the celebration of my brother's marriage, an occasion that simply would not feel complete without you. （应用文·邀请信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I would be delighted if... 虚拟语气显诚恳 + grace us with your presence 敬语替换口语 come + 同位语从句（an occasion that...）表达对方在自己心中的分量

classPractice.question: We were all invited to attend their ____ (marriage / wedding) at the seaside church last June.
classPractice.note: 指'婚礼仪式'这一活动用 wedding；marriage 侧重'婚姻状态'这一长期关系

classPractice.question: Darwin decided to ____ (marriage) only after weighing the advantages and disadvantages.
classPractice.note: 空处需动词'结婚'；名词 marriage → 动词 marry；decide to do 后接动词原形

classPractice.question: 在结婚之前，达尔文列出了婚姻的利与弊。Before his ____, Darwin listed the advantages and disadvantages of ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点；before one's marriage 结婚前，两处均用名词 marriage（婚姻）
